We are unable to assess… pending…
We have not been provided with details of the recognition basis.
traps: 🚨 roughly 5 to 8 million 这种给区间的说法，和 We are unable to quantify… pending… 是两种完全不同的语气，别混用
用 hedge 代替 defer（the impact may be around…）—— 判断根本做不出来，不是做出来了但不确定
说 we couldn't find it，把管理层没记录说成你没找到
dd_delivery_timing.ai: 买方 deal lead。他有 deadline 压力，会说 just give me your best estimate，但这是想推进，不是在为难你。你说清楚为什么给不了，他听得进去。
dd_delivery_timing.task: 说清为什么给不出这个数、以及你打算在报告里怎么写

tgt: I lead the financial due diligence workstream.
I have run similar deals in the payments and media sectors over the past six years.
On this project I will be your main contact for anything on the numbers.
traps: 🚨 背简历流水账 —— 30 秒说了五份工作，客户一个字没记住
过度谦虚到听不出你能干什么
说完不说自己负责哪块，客户不知道该找谁
wk_intro_credentials.ai: 客户方 CFO。礼貌、话不多，会在你介绍完之后接一个具体的业务问题，不是考你，是他本来就想知道。
wk_intro_credentials.task: 30 秒说清你是谁、做过什么相关的、这个项目上你负责哪块

tgt: The scope has changed since we agreed the fee — two additional entities.
That is roughly forty additional hours on our side.
I wanted to raise it now rather than at the end.
traps: We need more money 太生硬；英语里从 The scope has changed 讲起
用 sorry to bring this up 开场，一上来就把自己放低了
只说工作量增加，不说具体多少，对方没法判断
aud_fee_conversation.ai: 客户财务总监。预算已经定了，会说今年很紧，但不是不讲理，会问多出来的工作具体是什么。
aud_fee_conversation.task: 把加钱说成工作量的变化，而不是要求

tgt: Could we schedule a 15-minute call to align on the audit timeline for FY25?
Does tomorrow afternoon work for you, or would Thursday be better?
I want to make sure we stay on track with our fieldwork.
traps: Avoid 'Can we talk?', use 'align on the audit timeline'.
Avoid 'Is that okay?', use 'Does... work for you'.
Avoid 'finish on time', use 'stay on track with our fieldwork'.
aud_confirm_meeting_time.ai: 忙碌的财务经理，一直想约时间，但总是被琐事打断。
aud_confirm_meeting_time.task: 敲定沟通会议的具体时间点。

tgt: Could you confirm if the FY25 consolidated financial statements include all active subsidiaries?
Are there any entities that are currently excluded from the consolidation scope?
I want to ensure we have a comprehensive understanding of the group structure.
traps: Use 'consolidated financial statements' instead of 'the numbers'.
Use 'consolidation scope' instead of 'what you put in the list'.
Use 'comprehensive' instead of 'full' to sound more analytical.
dd_verify_entity_scope.ai: 你是合并报表主管。你很专业，明确知道哪些并了，哪些因为规模太小没并。
dd_verify_entity_scope.task: 核实合并报表涵盖的实体范围。

tgt: We have identified a recurring discrepancy between the management accounts and the statutory figures.
A structured reconciliation would greatly assist us in understanding the nature of these adjustments.
Could we focus on the top three items that account for the majority of this variance?
traps: 避免 'Your numbers are inconsistent'，改用 'identified a discrepancy'，更客观。
避免 'Give me a sheet'，改用 'A structured reconciliation would assist us'，提升专业度。
避免 'The numbers don't match' (中式直译)，使用 'account for the majority of this variance'。
dd_clarify_discrepancy.ai: 财务经理，被反复询问搞得很疲惫。他认为调节项都是细节，不知道为什么财务人这么纠结这些差异。
dd_clarify_discrepancy.task: 在时间压力下，请对方提供结构化的调节说明。

tgt: No worries at all, I understand how busy things get.
Since we have a full agenda, shall we dive straight into the key items?
Let’s make the most of our remaining time to ensure we cover all the necessary topics.
traps: Avoid 'You are late', use 'I understand how busy things get' to save face.
Avoid 'hurry up', use 'dive straight into' for professional efficiency.
Avoid 'Let's start now', use 'make the most of our remaining time' to sound goal-oriented.
wk_address_meeting_delay.ai: 你是目标公司的财务总监，前一个会没控制住时间。你对迟到感到抱歉，希望能尽快进入核心议题。
wk_address_meeting_delay.task: 礼貌开启会议，并示意尽快开始以弥补延误时间。

tgt: I need to flag a critical finding regarding the ownership status of the main production facility.
This title issue poses a significant risk to the valuation and may require a legal opinion.
I suggest we pause the valuation section and escalate this to the client's legal counsel for clarification.
traps: Avoid 'There's a big problem' (too vague); use 'flag a critical finding'.
Avoid 'It might cost a lot' (emotional); use 'poses a significant risk to the valuation'.
Avoid 'I don't know what to do' (lacks leadership); use 'I suggest we pause... and escalate'.
wk_report_critical_finding.ai: 项目合伙人，非常在意风险，喜欢听取简明扼要的事实陈述和解决方案，讨厌含糊其辞。
wk_report_critical_finding.task: 向合伙人简述事实并建议下一步方案

tgt: I noticed a significant spike in the repair and maintenance expenses for December FY25.
Could you clarify the nature of this particular transaction?
Is this a recurring annual maintenance cost, or is it a one-off project?
traps: Avoid 'Why is this money so big?' (unprofessional). Use 'significant spike'.
Avoid 'Is this a one-time thing?' (too casual). Use 'one-off project'.
Avoid 'What is the nature of this money?' (inaccurate). Use 'nature of this transaction'.
dd_clarify_maintenance_expenses.ai: 财务经理，很忙，但这笔账确实是他经手的，他记得是厂房大修，很乐意解释原因以尽快结束问询。
dd_clarify_maintenance_expenses.task: 询问该笔大额维修费用的性质，以及是否属于年度常规支出。

tgt: We noticed a significant dip in R&D expenses during Q3 26 compared to the first half of the year.
Could you walk me through the underlying factors behind this downward trend?
Does this decline reflect a shift in the development lifecycle, or is it related to capitalization adjustments?
traps: 避免使用 'why is the cost down' (太简单)，使用 'underlying factors behind this trend' 更符合专业语域。
避免使用 'tell me about it' (太随意)，使用 'walk me through' (专业语域)。
避免使用 'the money went down' (中式直译)，应使用 'a significant dip in expenses' 或 'decline'。
dd_r_and_d_fluctuation_5076.ai: 你是研发部负责人，你觉得 Q3 费用下降是因为项目进入了量产阶段，不是什么财务问题。你现在很忙，不想在这些琐事上浪费时间。
dd_r_and_d_fluctuation_5076.task: 询问研发费用下降背后的具体运营原因

tgt: The delay is primarily due to data integrity issues arising from the recent ERP migration.
We are currently working with their IT team to perform a manual reconciliation of the affected accounts.
I expect to have the validated data ready for your review by Wednesday.
traps: 不要说 'The system is broken' (太口语，用 'data integrity issues')
避免 'I am trying to fix it' (用 'actively performing a manual reconciliation' 显得更有掌控力)
避免用 'Maybe it will be done on Wednesday' (语意模糊，要体现专业预判)
wk_explain_data_bottleneck.ai: 你的项目合伙人，他需要一个专业的解释来应对客户高层的压力。
wk_explain_data_bottleneck.task: 解释原因，并给出已经采取的补救措施和预期恢复时间。

tgt: I’ve noticed that the projected headcount expenses for FY26 don't seem to scale with the revenue growth targets.
Could you walk me through the underlying assumptions that justify such a reduction in labor costs?
I’m finding it difficult to see the link between the expansion plan and this specific cost forecast.
traps: 避免说 'You are wrong'，改用 'I'm finding it difficult to see' 表示客观上的疑惑。
不要使用中式思维的 'What is the logic behind this'，建议用更地道的 'walk me through the assumptions'。
注意 'headcount expenses' 比 'people money' 更专业。
dd_challenging_cost_budget.ai: 你是财务总监，你认为这些成本节约是通过数字化转型实现的，你很自信，认为顾问不理解公司的战略。
dd_challenging_cost_budget.task: 礼貌但坚定地质疑预算假设的合理性，要求对方解释增长逻辑。

tgt: I noticed a 2% variance between the sub-ledger and the general ledger for 9M26.
Could you walk me through the specific logic behind this system conversion gap?
Is this variance expected to be cleared by the period-end, or does it reflect a data integrity issue?
traps: 不要说 'there is a difference'，用 'variance' 在审计语境更精确。
不要用 'explain me the logic'（语法错误），应使用 'walk me through the logic'。
避免使用口语词 'fix'，在财务审计中 'clear' 或 'resolve' 差异更专业。
wk_reconcile_gl_diff.ai: 客户方的会计主管，对系统操作很熟，但他习惯用‘系统问题’来解释一切，你需要引导他给出技术性解释。
wk_reconcile_gl_diff.task: 让对方解释差异的具体原因，并确认这是否会影响后续数据的准确性。

tgt: I noticed a significant legal fee payment in the FY25 general expenses.
Could you provide some context regarding the nature of this service?
Is there a supporting contract or invoice available that I could review?
traps: Avoid 'Why you paid so much money?' (Tone: sounds like an interrogation; use 'nature of this service').
Avoid 'What is this for?' (Register: use 'provide some context' for more formal inquiry).
Avoid 'I need to see the proof' (Tone: use 'could I review' to sound cooperative).
dd_inquire_legal_fee_nature.ai: 你是法务专员，这笔费用是针对一个临时的知识产权诉讼支付的。因为处理得很紧急，归档还没完全做好。
dd_inquire_legal_fee_nature.task: 礼貌询问该项大额法律费用的性质

tgt: This variance requires a thorough investigation to ensure the integrity of the consolidated financial statements.
Even if the amount seems immaterial, we need to understand if it stems from a system reconciliation issue.
Could we prioritize identifying the root cause before we finalize the intercompany consolidation?
traps: Avoid 'it's a small amount' (colloquial); use 'the magnitude is not the primary concern here'.
Don't use 'just fix it'; use 'please provide a reconciliation for the discrepancy'.
Avoid 'I don't care'; focus on 'the audit trail must be complete'.
aud_related_party_offset_5431.ai: 你是财务主管。你非常忙碌，认为这500万港币相对集团收入微不足道，希望能直接平账了事。
aud_related_party_offset_5431.task: 强调抵销差异背后的内控风险，坚持必须查明差异原因。

tgt: Given the technical issues with the ERP migration, I understand that the data extraction is delayed.
What is the earliest realistic timeframe we can expect the complete report?
Let’s adjust our internal schedule to prioritize other modules while your team resolves the system issue.
traps: 不要说 'I need it now'，要展现出对 'technical issues' 的体谅
不要用 'when can you give it to me'，应使用 'What is the earliest realistic timeframe'
避免使用 'I'll wait'，应使用 'Let’s adjust our internal schedule' 显得你在积极管理项目
wk_negotiate_erp_delay.ai: 你是财务总监，系统崩溃让你焦头烂额。你很焦虑，希望能得到宽限，而不是被催促。
wk_negotiate_erp_delay.task: 与对方达成一致，延后关键财务报表的交付时间

tgt: I’ve noticed some large prepayment balances that have been outstanding for over a year.
Could you provide an update on the status of these projects and when they are expected to be settled?
Are there any specific reasons why these have not yet been recognized as expenses?
traps: Avoid 'Why is the money still here', use 'outstanding for over a year' (professional).
Avoid 'I want to know the reason', use 'Could you provide an update' (softer tone).
Use 'settled' instead of 'paid back' for prepayments.
dd_clarify_prepayment_nature.ai: 你是一名业务财务，你负责这个项目，你认为这只是正常的商业进度，对方之所以还没开票是因为工程还没验收。
dd_clarify_prepayment_nature.task: 询问长期挂账的预付账款的原因及其结算计划。

tgt: In the historical accounts, the target brand was utilized free of charge as part of the group's internal arrangement.
This is a classic 'carve-out adjustment' where we must overlay a pro-forma brand royalty fee of 2% of revenue.
This overlay will reduce the historical and forecasted EBITDA run-rate, but it reflects the true standalone cost structure.
traps: 将“无偿/免费”说成 'no money' 或 'without money'。专业地道的财务英语中，这叫 'free of charge'，'at zero cost' 或者是 'provided on an unallocated basis'。
将“特许权使用费”直译为 'brand using price'。正确的行业术语是 'brand royalty fee' 或 'license fee'。
用 'The money will go down' 表达EBITDA下降。应当用 'This adjustment will reduce/impact the historical EBITDA run-rate' 或 'result in a downward adjustment to EBITDA'。
dd_carve_brand_royalty.ai: Alex是买方的投资总监（买方代表）。他注意到分拆报表里没有品牌费，感到疑惑，询问你这笔费用对未来的9M26和FY26F预测数据的具体EBITDA影响有多大。
dd_carve_brand_royalty.task: 向买方投资总监合理解释这一“未分摊/免费服务”的概念，并说明如何通过模拟调整（Pro-forma adjustment）在历史及预测EBITDA中扣除这笔2%的品牌费。

tgt: Sure, let's skip ahead to slide 12 as Alex suggested.
For our enterprise accounts, the main churn driver was the lack of ISO 27001 compliance certification in Q2.
We have since accelerated our compliance audit and expect to get certified by the end of Q3.
traps: 说 "Go to page 12" 表达跳到12页。习惯用 "page" 代替 "slide"，地道表达应为 "Let me jump to slide 12" 或 "Skipping ahead to slide 12".
用 "The reason is customer don't like us" 直译流失原因。过于幼稚且不专业，地道表达应为 "The key driver behind this churn was a compliance gap".
说 "We will do certification fastly" 出现语法错误（"fastly" 不是副词）。地道表达应为 "We are accelerating our certification process".
wk_ppt_churn_analysis.ai: Alex 扮演客户成功负责人。他在答疑阶段请你跳到第 12 页，具体解释大客户（ACV > $50k）流失的主要原因。
wk_ppt_churn_analysis.task: 配合跳页，解释大客户流失主要是因为缺失某项 ISO 数据安全认证，并说明补救进度。

tgt: During our 9M26 compliance review, we identified a 5% variance in VAT input credit.
We are currently reconciling the underlying invoices to determine the root cause.
I will provide you with the full breakdown once we complete the secondary verification.
traps: 避免使用 'There is a wrong number'，应使用 'There is a variance'，'wrong number' 太口语化且不专业。
避免说 'I check the files'，应使用 'We are reconciling the documents'，'reconcile' 是财务核心术语。
避免使用 'I'll give you a list later'，应使用 'I will provide a breakdown'，'breakdown' 在汇报工作中更精准。
wk_status_tax_discrepancy.ai: Alex 是财务结算组的负责人，他需要明确这个误差是否会触发税务预警，希望你给出初步判断。
wk_status_tax_discrepancy.task: 告知对方存在数据差异，并说明目前复核的进展

tgt: Before we wrap up, let me briefly summarize the key points we discussed regarding the FY25 gross margin drop.
Just to confirm, we will receive the detailed margin breakdown table by Thursday, right?
Thank you, Alex, for your time and clear explanations today. We will touch base if any further questions arise.
traps: 说成 'Before we finish, I say what we talked'，中文直译严重，地道表达是用 'Before we wrap up, let me briefly summarize the key points...'。
说成 'You will give me the table on Thursday, yes?'，语法结构松散，地道表达是用 'Just to confirm, we will receive the detailed margin breakdown table by Thursday, right?'。
说成 'Thank you very much, bye'，过于简陋，地道表达是用 'Thank you, Alex, for your time and clear explanations today...'。
wk_meet_client_interview_wrap.ai: Alex，目标公司的财务总监。他很配合，表示会在3个工作日内提供详细的毛利拆分表。
wk_meet_client_interview_wrap.task: 做会议收尾，向客户确认下一步的资料交付节点并致谢。

tgt: We identified an oversight in the internal control documentation for these transactions.
We are currently updating the files to include the missing approval logs.
This update will strengthen our testing evidence without changing the overall control effectiveness conclusion.
traps: 使用 'We made a mistake'。应说 'We identified a documentation gap'，使用专业词汇描述偏差。
说 'It's no big deal'。应说 'This is a minor documentation issue that we are actively addressing'。
过度解释 'why'。直接陈述事实和补救措施即可，不要找借口。
aud_qc_internal_control_gap.ai: Alex 是内审负责人，他觉得这只是小操作失误，担心这会影响内控审计的结论完整性。
aud_qc_internal_control_gap.task: 说明补录计划，并确保不影响最终审计结论。

tgt: What was the methodology used to allocate the HR shared service costs for the 9M26 period?
Given the headcount of 500 employees, the current allocation seems lower than the industry benchmark.
Could you provide a breakdown of how the corporate HR time was tracked and assigned to this entity?
traps: 常说 'The fee is too cheap'，不地道。应说 'The allocation seems to be on the lower end' 或 'below market rate'。
常说 'How do you calculate this?'，缺乏专业感。应使用 'What was the methodology used for the allocation?'。
常说 'This doesn't match the headcount'。建议使用 'Given the headcount, the allocation requires further clarification'。
dd_carve_shared_hr_service.ai: 目标公司HR总监，认为这是内部服务，按历史协议分摊，愿意配合解释成本动因。
dd_carve_shared_hr_service.task: 通过询问成本分摊逻辑，找出费用被低估的原因。

tgt: We need to assess whether the company acts as a principal or an agent in this transaction.
Does the company have primary responsibility for fulfilling the order and latitude in setting prices?
Reporting on a net basis might be more appropriate if credit risk is the only exposure.
traps: 把总额法说成 total amount method, which is a literal translation. The professional term is 'gross basis' or 'gross reporting'.
把净额法说成 small amount method, completely missing the accounting concept. It is 'net basis' or 'netting off'.
用了 have right to set price, which lacks articles and sounds awkward. Correct phrasing is 'has latitude in establishing prices'.
dd_rev_principal_agent.ai: 标公司项目财务经理。他认为公司承担了仓储和物流风险，因此有权按总额法确认收入。
dd_rev_principal_agent.task: 通过分析履约时是否承担主要责任及定价自主权，探讨是否应调减为净额法。

tgt: Should we classify these payments as severance or as a settlement for social security shortfalls?
What are the potential tax implications of recording this as a one-time exit payment?
We need to ensure the accounting treatment is consistent with the nature of the underlying liability.
traps: 常说：'You want to hide it.'（语气攻击）。应说：'How should we best disclose this item in the financial records to ensure clarity?'
常说：'It is not a good idea.'（模糊）。应说：'Are there any potential tax risks associated with this classification?'
常说：'The tax bureau will find you.'（不专业）。应说：'We need to consider how this would be viewed during a potential tax audit.'
dd_hr_severance_vs_socsec.ai: 合伙人，希望这笔钱能以“离职补偿”入账，以规避“社保补缴”引发的税务审查。
dd_hr_severance_vs_socsec.task: 指出会计处理的规范性，提醒若归类为补偿金可能产生的税务抵扣风险

tgt: Would you be available for a 30-minute brief on Thursday afternoon to discuss the FY24 compliance risk?
I'd like to walk you through our initial findings before we finalize the report.
Please let me know if another time works better for your schedule.
traps: 使用 "I want to have a meeting with you"，"I want" 语气过于直白，应使用 "I would like to request a meeting"。
使用 "Do you have time?"，太模糊且随意，应具体化为 "Do you have 30 minutes to discuss..."。
使用 "Please tell me your time"，语法错误，应使用 "Please let me know your availability"。
wk_email_meeting_invite.ai: 合伙人，时间宝贵但非常支持团队，会查看日程并确认时间。
wk_email_meeting_invite.task: 建议一个具体时间，并简要说明会议目的，表现出专业性。

tgt: We need to ensure that shared costs are appropriately allocated between the entities.
Could you outline the methodology used for the cost-sharing arrangement?
Under HKSA, we must reflect the economic impact of shared resources in the financial statements.
traps: 使用 'You have to pay'，这涉及到内部账务处理，应说 'We need to account for the allocation of these expenses.'
使用 'This is wrong'，过于主观，应说 'This treatment may not align with the accounting standards.'
使用 'It is just a small amount'，显得不专业，应说 'Even if the impact is immaterial, we need to document the basis for this decision.'
aud_rp_common_control.ai: Alex扮演集团财务BP。他认为这属于集团内部资源共享，不涉及现金流转，没必要做账务调整。
aud_rp_common_control.task: 要求对方按公允价值对费用进行分摊，并确保财务报表反映真实负债或开支。

tgt: Karen, you must be exhausted after navigating that board meeting all afternoon. The braised duck here is quite light, hope you like it.
Our team has wrapped up the core working capital analysis, and the numbers are tracking very closely with our initial synergy model.
Everything is on track for us to deliver the final sign-off package ahead of the Thursday deadline.
traps: 说成 "You are very tired today, you should eat more food." 听起来像长辈管教。地道商务关切应用 "Karen, you must be exhausted after navigating that board meeting..."
用 "Our working capital math is done and correct." 用词不够专业。地道表述应为 "wrapped up the core working capital analysis, and the numbers are tracking very closely..."
用 "We will finish on time, don't worry about us." 显得缺乏说服力。地道说法是 "Everything is on track for us to deliver the final sign-off package..."
wk_small_client_cfo_dinner.ai: Karen，集团 CFO，女强人风格但对尽调团队一直很器重。她刚刚结束了一整天的董事会沟通，现在想吃点清淡的，并听听你对整体收购溢价（Premium）的专业直觉。
wk_small_client_cfo_dinner.task: 在温馨的晚餐开场中，用英语向买方 CFO 汇报整体尽调进度并适当排解其焦虑

tgt: We saw that the parent company provided a guarantee for the bank loan of RMB 10 million.
Was there any guarantee fee charged by the parent company for this arrangement?
Could you share the bank facility agreement showing the guarantee terms?
traps: 使用 "Does the parent company want money for helping you borrow?"。错误原因：表达过于口语和幼稚，应使用 'Did the parent company charge a guarantee fee?'。
Use "Is this guarantee for free?"。错误原因：'for free' 偏口语，商务财税中常用 'provided on a gratuitous basis' 或 'free of charge'。
Use "Give me the bank paper to see."。错误原因：银行授信文件应用 'bank facility agreement' 或 'loan agreement'。
dd_rp_guarantee_fee.ai: Alex，目标公司的资金经理。他很配合，确认该笔担保是由大股东无偿提供的，未收取任何担保费。
dd_rp_guarantee_fee.task: 确认银行借款合同中关于大股东担保的具体条款，并核实历史上是否有支付担保费的先例。

tgt: Alex, I noticed three related-party transactions were missed in our 9M26 working papers.
Even though the schedule was dense, cross-checking the trial balance is non-negotiable.
Please get these three schedules updated and cross-referenced by the end of today.
traps: 误用 'missed out'，地道表达应直接用 'missed' 或 'were omitted'。
使用 'must do' 语气过硬，地道商务口语常用 'Please get these updated' 显得专业。
直译 'cross checking' 为动词短语时漏掉连字符或介词，正确搭配为 'cross-reference with'。
wk_fb_audit_adjustments.ai: Alex 是你的资深审计员。他听到后会解释说是因为客户提供的明细表在最后一页被折叠漏看了，并询问是否可以明天下午补上底稿。
wk_fb_audit_adjustments.task: 指出遗漏事实，要求 Alex 在今天下班前完成这 3 笔底稿的补充与交叉复核。

tgt: Could you confirm if the fire safety upgrades requested by the authorities in March have been fully implemented?
Do you have the invoices and completion certificates for the 20 new fire-fighting units?
It is crucial for our review that we have documentation proving the remediation is closed.
traps: 使用 'The problem is fixed'，'closed' 或 'remediated' 是更专业的合规术语。
使用 'Find me the bills'，应使用 'Could you provide the invoices/supporting documents?'。
使用 'We need to close the loop'，虽然地道，但需加 'It is crucial that...' 以增强专业职场感。
dd_esg_safety_inspection_record.ai: 工厂设备科主管。他表示设备已于6月完成更换，正在找发票和验收单。
dd_esg_safety_inspection_record.task: 确认整改已闭环并获取相关付款证明。

tgt: I'm looking for some clarity on how the new regulations affect our cross-border settlement process.
Could you walk me through the specific documentation requirements for this transaction type?
Are there any particular red flags we should be aware of when preparing the submission?
traps: 使用 'Tell me exactly what to do'，命令语气，应说 'Could you provide some guidance on...?'。
使用 'Your email is not clear'，太直接，应说 'Could you please clarify a few points?'。
使用 'What is your bad meaning?'，词汇误用，应说 'What are the potential implications?'。
wk_new_bank_communication.ai: 银行客户经理。试图用模糊的官话规避责任，不愿给出明确建议。
wk_new_bank_communication.task: 引导对方给出具体的合规执行指引，而非外交辞令。

tgt: We noticed an expense claim of HK$800,000 related to executive travel and business consulting with limited supporting documentation.
Could you help us understand the special approval workflow used for this specific executive claim?
We would appreciate it if you could provide the board resolution or executive sign-off for these expenses.
traps: 使用 'The boss spent too much money without approval.'。毛病：措辞过于口语化且有指责嫌疑。地道说法为 'We noted that this claim did not follow the standard approval workflow, so we need executive sign-off.'。
直译 'Give me the boss's receipt.'。毛病：称呼 'boss' 不符合专业商务规范，应称为 'executive' 或 'director'。地道说法为 'Could you provide the itemized receipts and the corresponding approval records?'。
使用 'This is an abnormal travel cost.'。毛病：'abnormal' 带有审计专业认定色彩，沟通过程中易引发反感。地道说法为 'This expense exceeds our regular testing threshold, so we need additional documentation.'
aud_fraud_director_expense_claim.ai: Alex扮演财务主管。他很乐意协助，解释说该笔费用属于董事会特批的海外商务拓展项目，由于涉及保密条款，当时走的是董事长直接特批的简化报销流程，并会补齐相关会议纪要。
aud_fraud_director_expense_claim.task: 确认该笔80万港币报销的董事会授权文件、商务行程及合规性凭证。

tgt: We must maintain control over the confirmation process for FY25 audits.
Never let the client's staff mail the confirmation letters on our behalf.
We need to drop these letters into the post box ourselves.
traps: Saying 'Client cannot help us send letters.' 表达不地道，应强调 'maintain control over the confirmation process'。
Saying 'Do not let client mail them.' 缺少主语修饰和专业词汇，应用 'client's staff mail the confirmation letters on our behalf'。
Saying 'We must post them by our hands.' 'by our hands' 是直译，地道说法是 'ourselves' 或 'drop these letters into the post box ourselves'。
aud_conf_direct_confirmation_control.ai: Alex是新助理，他刚意识到操作不合规，虚心听取你关于审计独立性和函证控制的要求。
aud_conf_direct_confirmation_control.task: 向Alex强调审计项目组必须亲自控制函证的寄送全过程，不得经由客户代寄。

tgt: We anticipate issuing an unmodified audit opinion on the financial statements.
The final audit report is ready for release following today's committee endorsement.
We appreciate the strong cooperation from the finance team throughout the engagement.
traps: 说成 "We plan to give a clean opinion on the financials"。"give a clean opinion" 偏口语，正式场合应用 "issue an unmodified audit opinion"。
说成 "The final report can be released after the committee says OK"。"says OK" 极不正式，应说 "following today's committee endorsement"。
说成 "We want to thank the finance team for helping us so much"。感谢辞用语不够商务，应用 "appreciate the strong cooperation from the finance team throughout the engagement"。
aud_ac_audit_conclusion_preview.ai: Alex 扮演审计委员会独立董事。他听到审计进展顺利表示满意，并询问正式签署审计报告的具体日期。
aud_ac_audit_conclusion_preview.task: 向审计委员会明确拟出具无保留意见的审计结论及报告发布时间表。

tgt: This error in the cut-off testing is a significant oversight and jeopardizes our entire revenue conclusion.
You need to re-verify the entire foreign currency data set immediately; we cannot present this to the partner as is.
Given the timeline, I need your absolute focus on correcting the source data before we meet with the engagement partner.
traps: Avoid 'You made a big mistake.' as it's too personal; use 'This is a significant oversight' to focus on the deliverable.
Avoid 'The data is wrong.' as it's ambiguous; use 'You need to re-verify the entire foreign currency data set' to give a clear instruction.
Avoid 'Fix it now.' as it's an imperative command; use 'I need your focus on correcting the source data' to maintain a professional tone.
aud_team_review_error.ai: Alex是高级审计师，他认为自己只是笔误，想私下修正，不想把事情闹大。
aud_team_review_error.task: 严厉指出错误的严重性，要求立即重新核实所有外币交易数据，并确保风险可控。

tgt: We've noticed a discrepancy between the reported salary and the social security contribution base.
Could you elaborate on the tax filing status for the international assignees in FY26?
We need to quantify the potential exposure related to the social insurance and IIT underpayments.
traps: 使用 'You broke the law'，直接判罪；应改为 'There are potential compliance gaps we need to address'。
使用 'Your HR records are messy'，贬低对方工作；应改为 'The payroll data currently requires some reconciliation'。
使用 'You have to pay the money back'，越权；应改为 'We need to assess the financial impact of potential adjustments'。
dd_tax_personal_income.ai: HR总监，认为这是行业常态，担心调整会导致员工不满和高昂的额外成本，试图淡化此事。
dd_tax_personal_income.task: 指出潜在的社保补缴风险和个人所得税欠缴风险，并要求获取高管薪酬明细。

tgt: Could you clarify whether the 5% ESOP stake comes from existing share transfer or new issuance in FY25?
Please share the ESOP plan and relevant agreements.
Who are the participants in the employee shareholding plan?
traps: 错误说法：ESOP has 5% shares. 不地道：应为ESOP holds a 5% equity stake，shares指代模糊，地道说：The ESOP holds a 5% equity stake.

错误说法：Is it from old shares or new? 不地道：old shares应为existing share transfer，语气太随意，应为whether it comes from existing share transfer or new equity issuance，地道说：whether the stake comes from existing share transfer or new issuance.
错误说法：Give me the ESOP paper. 不地道：paper口语化，应为ESOP plan，应为Could you share...
dd_equity_esop_origin.ai: Alex是目标公司HR负责人，立场配合，诉求是说明ESOP股权来源，愿意提供ESOP方案及相关协议，希望尽调团队确认合规性。

tgt: Given the sudden update in local VAT regulations for FY25, the scope of our review has naturally expanded.
We need to issue a separate variation order to cover the additional 45 hours incurred for these four overseas entities.
Let's look at how we can formally document this adjustment so the engagement team can proceed smoothly.
traps: 使用 'Your policy has changed, so you must pay more'。这样说太生硬且具有攻击性。地道说法是用客观事实引导：'Given the recent updates in regulatory requirements, we need to adjust our scope accordingly.'
使用 'This is outside our contract'。虽然语法没错，但在商务沟通中略显对抗。地道说法是：'This falls outside our initial baseline estimation for FY25.'
使用 'We spent 45 hours, you should give us money'。动词 give us money 带有索要性质，不符合专业服务调性。地道说法是：'This entails an additional 45 hours of professional time, which requires a fee adjustment.'
aud_fee_scope_creep_advisory.ai: Alex 是该客户端的财务总监。他认为税务新规属于行业通用环境变化，审计组将其纳人常规审计范围理所应当，对额外收费持保留态度。
aud_fee_scope_creep_advisory.task: 说服对方财务总监确认这 4 家实体的增值税复核属于增量工作，并签署 3.5 万港元的补充服务确认函。

tgt: Our role is to validate the historical inputs, but the valuation model sits outside our scope.
We can certainly provide the supporting schedules, but the WACC calculation requires a specialized valuation expert.
Let’s keep our focus on the financial audit to ensure we deliver the report on time.
traps: 说成 'This is not my business' 很粗鲁，应说 'Valuation modeling is outside the scope of our FDD engagement'。
将 'I can't do the model' 说成 'We are not positioned to provide a valuation opinion'。
说成 'Ask someone else' 显得推诿，应说 'We recommend engaging a valuation specialist for this assessment'。
dd_scope_valuation_dispute.ai: 项目牵头人。他希望你能承担更多职责，以此减少雇佣第三方估值专家的开支。
dd_scope_valuation_dispute.task: 明确职责分工，说明财务尽调团队只能提供数据支撑，无法提供估值结论。

tgt: What’s the calculation basis for the withholding tax saving on slide 11?
The saving is calculated based on the applicable tax treaties between China and Country X.
We’ve cross-checked the treaty clauses to ensure eligibility.
traps: 错误："Calculate is easy." → 名词作动词误用，应使用动词calculate，地道表达为"The saving is calculated as..."
错误："It’s very good." → 表述模糊，专业场景应明确价值，地道表达为"This saving is substantial and aligns with treaty provisions."
错误："We have many documents." → 表述不具体，地道表达为"We have the treaty ratification documents and tax filings for reference."
wk_ppt_tax_partner_slide11.ai: Alex是事务所税务合伙人，立场是评估优化方案可行性，诉求是确认节省金额计算逻辑，避免税务风险。
wk_ppt_tax_partner_slide11.task: 清晰说明节省金额计算依据，确认方案合规性，推进方案讨论

tgt: With the 8 new offshore accounts opened in Cayman and Singapore, we experienced higher bank confirmation and courier charges.
The total out-of-pocket cost for these foreign bank confirmations comes to 4,000 RMB.
We would like to add this amount as a disbursement fee in the final invoice.
traps: 用了 'you opened too many bank accounts'。带埋怨情绪，应说 'with the 8 new offshore accounts opened'。,
用了 'bank letter cost'。不够专业，地道说法是 'bank confirmation and courier charges'。,
用了 'you need to reimburse us the cash'。口语化严重，应说 'add this amount as a disbursement fee in the final invoice'。
aud_fee_additional_bank_confirmation.ai: Alex，客户方的出纳主管。她积极配合工作，确认了新增账户的情况，并同意按照实报实销方式支付这笔函证成本。
aud_fee_additional_bank_confirmation.task: 向客户说明新增的 8 个境外离岸账户产生了额外的银行函证手续费和国际快递费，共计 4,000 元，需在尾款中补收。

tgt: Although the final inspection is pending, the asset has already been brought into operational use.
We need to transfer the balance to fixed assets and commence depreciation accordingly.
Delaying the transfer results in a material impact on the profit and loss account for the current year.
traps: 说 'It's already working'，像在聊天。应说 'The asset has reached a state of operational readiness.'
使用 'You're hiding the depreciation'，语气太重。应说 'The depreciation expense has not been recognized yet.'
说 'Just move it'，无礼。应说 'We advise that this item be reclassified as a fixed asset.'
aud_adj_construction_in_progress.ai: 客户基建经理。借口工程还没完全通过验收，不愿转为固定资产。
aud_adj_construction_in_progress.task: 要求立即转固并补提折旧。

tgt: The legal documents for the ongoing IP dispute in VDR are currently incomplete.
Could external counsel provide an interim legal memo regarding the potential provision?
We need this to assess the financial impact for our DD report.
traps: 把未决诉讼说成 'unresolved lawsuit'。专业尽调中更常用 'ongoing dispute' 或 'pending litigation'
把法律备忘录说成 'legal letter'。地道说法是 'legal memo' 或 'legal opinion'
说 'see how much money to pay' 太口语。地道说法是 'assess the financial impact'
dd_vdr_pending_litigation_docs.ai: Alex 扮演标公司法务主管，他表示外聘律所还在评估胜诉率，正式的法律意见书（Legal Opinion）下周才能出具。
dd_vdr_pending_litigation_docs.task: 请对方让外所先出一份阶段性评估函（Interim Memo）上传至 VDR，以便评估拨备计提。

tgt: The vendor in question doesn't seem to hold the required license for hazardous waste disposal.
Could you clarify the criteria used for selecting this specific waste management provider?
We need to assess the potential liabilities if this disposal method is found to be non-compliant.
traps: 不宜说“This contract is wrong.”，太主观；应说“This contract appears to be inconsistent with environmental compliance standards.”。
不宜说“You are cheating the rules.”，属于人身攻击；应说“There seems to be a discrepancy between the disposal standards and the current vendor selection.”。
不宜说“Is this vendor real?”，太口语化；应说“Could you provide verification of this vendor's current operational credentials?”。
dd_esg_waste_contract.ai: 目标公司财务总监。他表示这是为了节省运营成本的常规安排，并坚称对方有口头合规承诺。
dd_esg_waste_contract.task: 指出该处理路径可能存在的重大合规风险，并要求提供该供应商的环保经营许可证。

tgt: The GAAP to IFRS conversion is taking longer than anticipated due to the complexity of the overseas revenue recognition.
We are currently tracking two weeks behind our target for the 1H26 financial statements.
To catch up, I’ve reallocated two senior consultants to focus exclusively on this transition.
traps: Avoid 'it's too hard to do'. Better: 'It is more complex than anticipated' is standard project language.
Avoid 'we are failing'. Better: 'We are tracking behind our target' is a more professional way to describe a delay.
Avoid 'I will fix it soon'. Better: 'I have reallocated resources to catch up' shows concrete action.
wk_status_ipo_readiness_lag.ai: 投行项目经理 Alex，他关心这是否会拖累 IPO 上市的时间表，需要你给出明确的保证。
wk_status_ipo_readiness_lag.task: 坦诚进度滞后，解释转换难度，并提出增加人手赶工的计划。

tgt: The three unusual payments over 1M in 9M26 haven’t sent the confirmations yet because we’re verifying their counterparties.
We will send the follow-up confirmations by EOD this Friday.
This delay is due to confirming the identity of the third-party payers.
traps: 错误说法："the unusual payments" → 问题：应补充数量"three"更具体，地道说法："the three unusual payments"
错误说法："other companies" → 问题：专业财务场景应使用"counterparties"而非口语化的"other companies"
错误说法："haven’t had confirmations sent" → 问题：语法正确但不地道，地道说法："haven’t sent the confirmations"
dd_bank_partner_unusual_payments.ai: Alex是FDD项目合伙人，立场是把控项目质量，诉求是明确异常交易的尽调进度。
dd_bank_partner_unusual_payments.task: 解释未发函证的原因，提交具体的发函时间计划，获得合伙人认可。

tgt: The accounting records still reflect the original lease terms despite the office space reduction in FY25.
We need the executed lease modification agreement and the recalculation schedules for the right-of-use asset.
Could you provide the adjusted amortization schedule reflecting the revised lease payments?
traps: 动词时态错误：说成『You didn't change the numbers although you signed new paper.』。地道表达应用『still reflect the original lease terms despite...』。
专业名词直译：说成『We need the new rent paper and math table.』。应使用『lease modification agreement and the recalculation schedules』。
名词搭配不当：说成『Please give us the depreciation list.』。折旧和摊销明细表应用『amortization schedule』。
aud_evid_lease_modification_records.ai: Alex 扮演客户财务经理。他解释说虽然签了补充协议，但新租金的具体执行细节还在和物业核对，所以暂未调整账务。
aud_evid_lease_modification_records.task: 指出未根据租赁补充协议调整账务属于证据运用滞后，要求对方提供租赁变更协议及重新计量的测算表。

tgt: The dip in the liquidity ratio is a temporary result of the strategic capital expenditure made in Q3, which will be offset by the projected cash inflow in Q1 FY26.
We have run a stress test that confirms our current cash position remains sufficient to cover all interest payments.
I am preparing the detailed reconciliation report as requested to clarify that our debt-servicing capability remains strong.
traps: Avoid 'It is just a temporary thing' (too casual); use 'The dip is a result of strategic expenditure' to provide context.
Avoid 'You don't need to worry' (condescending); use 'The stress test confirms our cash position' to rely on data.
Avoid 'I will send the report eventually' (vague); use 'I am preparing the report as requested' to show urgency.
wk_self_bank_covenant.ai: Alex是银行客户经理，他态度严肃，要求你解释为何财务状况在短期内出现这种波动，以及企业是否有偿债能力。
wk_self_bank_covenant.task: 给出客观财务解释，提供支撑证据，并说服银行暂不触发惩罚性条款。

tgt: We need to assess if the 'Place of Effective Management' criteria might trigger local tax residency issues.
Even if registered offshore, the current management structure could imply a tax exposure in China.
Could we examine the correspondence and decision-making records for these entities?
traps: 说'You are paying the wrong tax'，太武断。应说'There might be a discrepancy regarding the tax residency status'。
说'The law says you are wrong'，对抗感强。应说'We should evaluate how the local tax authorities interpret the management residency rules'。
说'It's a big risk'，口语化。应说'This presents a significant tax exposure that requires careful consideration'。
dd_sub_overseas_tax_residency.ai: Alex是税务经理，辩称只要注册地在境外，就按当地法律缴纳企业所得税，与管理地无关。
dd_sub_overseas_tax_residency.task: 提示实际管理地（Place of Effective Management）可能导致双重纳税风险，需补充评估。

tgt: Let's review the audit schedule and ensure all requested schedules are ready before the interim fieldwork.
Before we wrap up, let's confirm the milestone dates for the revenue and cost testing.
Let's circle back to the point raised by the audit team regarding the supply chain finance documentation.
traps: 说成 Before we end the meeting... 不够职业，会议临近尾声的地道表达是 Before we wrap up 或 Before we conclude。
说成 Let's talk about that problem again. 重提某事地道表达应用 Let's circle back to the point raised by...
说成 Give the files to auditors on time. 略显生硬，强调按时提交材料应用 ensure all requested schedules are provided on schedule.
wk_meet_annual_audit_planning.ai: Alex 扮演外部审计合伙人。他肯定了你们去年的配合，但指出今年新增业务涉及复杂的实质重于形式判断，要求你们提前备好所有法律合同及资金流水底稿。
wk_meet_annual_audit_planning.task: 主持协调会控场，梳理审计底稿清单与时间表，确保各财务模块负责人按时向四大提供全套资料

tgt: We have completed the first draft of the FDD report, covering approximately 80% of our scope.
The remaining sections are pending the receipt of final supporting schedules.
Would you like to review the draft in its current state, or wait until we complete the final parts?
traps: 不要说 'The report is almost finished', 应说 'We are at an advanced stage of drafting the report'。前者太口语，后者更具专业进度感。
不要说 'I am waiting for them', 应说 'The completion of these sections is contingent on the requested data'。'Waiting for them' 显得被动，后者使用了专业的商务从句。
不要说 'Do you want to read it now?', 应说 'Would you like to review the preliminary draft?'。'Read it' 过于随意，'Review the draft' 是正式的审阅请求。
dd_deal_draft_report_update.ai: Alex是买方Deal Lead。他希望尽早看到初稿，哪怕是不完整的。
dd_deal_draft_report_update.task: 通报进度，明确后续行动计划。

tgt: We have issued the formal group audit instructions for the FY25 interim review.
Please ensure all confirmation replies are sent back to us by June 15th.
We need your signed memorandum on inventory count observations by the end of next week.
traps: 说成 'We give you the instruction letter' 太过口语和生硬，标准专业说法是 'We have issued the group audit instructions'。
催收时间时说 'You must give me back before June 15' 语气像催债，地道表达为 'Please ensure all confirmation replies are returned by June 15th'。
把备忘录说成 'note' 级别太低，审计底稿中的正式备忘录应用 'memorandum (memo)'。
aud_grp_group_audit_instructions.ai: Alex 是新加坡组件审计项目的负责人。他正在排期，需要确认你们对重大错报风险领域的具体工作要求和时间表。
aud_grp_group_audit_instructions.task: 清晰传达集团审计指令的核心时间节点和关键工作要求。

tgt: We have identified a discrepancy in the cash flow forecast within our FY25 report due to a data linkage issue.
We are currently recalibrating the model and will provide the corrected version by 5 PM today.
The deviation has been isolated, and it does not affect the overall conclusions of the report.
traps: 习惯说 'We made a mistake'，过于笼统。应说 'We have identified a technical discrepancy in our projection model'。
使用 'I am sorry for the trouble' 略显轻飘。地道表达应是 'We take full responsibility for this oversight and are taking immediate corrective action'。
常说 'It is not a big deal'，会激怒客户。应说 'We have assessed the impact, and it is limited to the secondary data points'。
wk_bad_internal_error.ai: 客户财务经理，立场是核对数据准确性，诉求是明确错误影响范围及修正时间表。
wk_bad_internal_error.task: 主动承认错误，说明修正方案，并保证不影响后续的决策进度。

tgt: I'm concerned that reducing the confirmation scope could expose us to significant audit risks.
We need to maintain the 80% threshold to ensure the integrity of our audit trail.
Could we explore ways to expedite the process without compromising the depth of our verification?
traps: Avoid 'You are wrong about the scope', which is too aggressive. Use 'I'm concerned that...' to state a professional disagreement.
Avoid 'Make it 80%', which is an imperative command. Use 'We need to maintain...' to frame it as a project requirement.
Avoid 'Don't worry about the time', which sounds dismissive. Use 'Could we explore ways to expedite...' to show collaborative problem solving.
wk_conf_audit_scope_limit.ai: 组长，认为 60% 覆盖率已足够，且强调目前的 9M26 数据显示集团现金流稳定，无需过度审计。
wk_conf_audit_scope_limit.task: 说服对方维持 80% 的函证覆盖率，保证审计底稿质量。

tgt: That's a vital oversight on our part regarding the director's affiliated entity.
We will add this procurement transaction to the related-party footnote right away.
Thanks for highlighting this compliance gap; we'll update our background check checklist.
traps: Didi说成 "We missed this relation."。relation指关系，交易往来应用 transaction，地道说法应用 "We missed this related-party transaction."
说成 "I will write it into the note."。write into不够专业，财务附注披露应用 disclose 或 include in the footnote，地道说法应用 "We will disclose this in the notes."
说成 "Thank you to tell me."。动词不定式做状语语法错误，地道说法应用 "Thank you for bringing this to our attention."
wk_takefb_related_party.ai: Alex 扮演法务合伙人。他提醒你这涉及合规披露风险，希望你把这笔150万元的采购补录进关联方清单。
wk_takefb_related_party.task: 承认检索范围有漏，感谢法务提醒，并答应立即补充披露

tgt: Revenue should be recognized based on the progress of performance obligations, not the receipt of cash.
Since only the first phase is complete, the remaining amount should be deferred as unearned revenue.
We need to ensure that the revenue recognition aligns with the delivery milestones specified in the contract.
traps: 忌用 'You haven't finished the work'，应说 'The performance obligations have not been fully satisfied'。
忌用 'It is not your money yet'，应说 'The revenue has not been earned yet'。
忌用 'The contract doesn't say that'，应说 'The contract outlines specific delivery milestones'。
aud_cut_deferred_revenue.ai: 客户销售总监，认为钱收到了，且合同已签，收入就该确认。
aud_cut_deferred_revenue.task: 依据履约义务完成度，要求冲回部分收入至预收账款。

tgt: I’ve managed GDPR-aligned financial data transfers for 5 EU clients in FY25.
I’m proficient in Art. 44 of GDPR on cross-border data transfers.
I can coordinate with internal teams to meet tight compliance deadlines.
traps: 直译“我懂GDPR”为“I know GDPR”，地道表达应为“I have hands-on experience with GDPR compliance for financial data”；
语气太委婉说“I might be able to handle it”，地道表述为“I can directly manage this compliance work”；
搭配错误使用“do GDPR”，正确搭配为“handle GDPR compliance”
wk_hire_compliance_vendor.ai: 扮演法务负责人，立场把控合规风险，诉求是确认对接人能快速推进数据传输合规，先就项目要求讨论
wk_hire_compliance_vendor.task: 15分钟内确认对接人GDPR财务数据传输经验，评估其响应速度

tgt: I acknowledge the variance in travel expenses and would like to provide the context behind these figures.
The unexpected travel to the European branch was necessitated by the urgent remediation of the $8.5M rental contract issue.
We have reviewed our internal approval process to ensure stricter cost oversight for the remainder of the project.
traps: 使用“It is not our fault”推卸责任，应使用“I acknowledge the variance”承认事实后再解释背景。
使用“Too expensive”描述机票价格，应使用“Premium pricing”或“Surge pricing”等商务词汇。
使用“I will fix it”显得随意，应使用“We have implemented stricter oversight”来体现系统性的改进。
wk_email_partner_review_discrepancy.ai: Alex扮演合伙人。他非常关注项目利润率，认为团队在控制成本方面缺乏审计应有的敏感度。
wk_email_partner_review_discrepancy.task: 客观解释超支原因（因临时赶赴欧洲处理紧急审计事项导致的机票溢价），并提出补救方案。

tgt: We need to conduct an on-site physical inventory count at their out-of-province warehouse.
Remote review is insufficient to verify their FY25 inventory existence.
May I get your approval for a three-person travel budget for next week?
traps: 使用 'Go to other province for checking'。实地盘点应用 on-site physical inventory count 或 site visit。
使用 'Looking at screen is not enough'。表达远程审阅不足应用 remote review is insufficient。
使用 'Ask for travel money'。申请差旅预算应用 travel budget approval 或 approval for travel expenses.
wk_boss_travel_budget.ai: Alex 扮演运营合伙人 Robert。他负责成本控制，需要听到必须实地前往的充分理由。
wk_boss_travel_budget.task: 向合伙人说明实地盘点的必要性，并获批3人次的差旅预算。

tgt: The financial statement includes some moving and office renovation costs in FY25.
Could you verify if these were one-off expenses related to the relocation?
We would like to add back these costs to arrive at the recurring EBITDA.
traps: 说 'moving house money'，应说 'relocation costs' 或 'moving expenses'。
说 'not daily cost'，应说 'non-recurring expense'。
说 'Fix the EBITDA'，应说 'Normalize the EBITDA' 或 'Adjust the EBITDA'。
dd_qoe_moving_expense.ai: 行政部门经理，确认这是搬迁导致的单次费用。
dd_qoe_moving_expense.task: 将搬迁费用确认为非经常性开支

tgt: What was the total value of the input VAT invoices that failed to be processed during the system cutover month?
Is there a remediation plan to backdate these entries, or will they be recognized in the subsequent quarter?
How do you plan to reconcile the discrepancy between the tax filings and the ERP records for 9M26?
traps: 使用 'input tax is missing'。地道说法是 'the input VAT was not captured in the system'。
使用 'talk to the tax bureau'。在正式交流中应使用 'liaise with tax authorities'。
使用 'do a recovery plan'。地道说法是 'implement a remediation plan' 或 'a corrective action plan'。
dd_sys_vat_input_staging.ai: Alex 是税务经理。他认为这是一个正常的过渡性技术故障，税务局那边已经有沟通方案，不影响整体税负。
dd_sys_vat_input_staging.task: 要求对方说明未处理进项税的具体金额，并确认是否有补录计划。

tgt: My recent process optimizations have reduced our project turnaround time by one week, significantly increasing our operational efficiency.
Given the cost savings I’ve generated through my project management improvements, I’d like to discuss a performance-based bonus.
I have streamlined our due diligence workflow, and I believe this effort warrants an adjustment to my incentive package.
traps: 使用'I made the work fast'，不地道，应说'I have increased our operational efficiency'。
使用'I saved you a lot of money'，太直接，应说'My process improvements have led to cost efficiencies for the firm'。
使用'I am very fast'，显得自大，应说'I have optimized our project workflows to maximize output'。
wk_raise_project_efficiency.ai: Alex是技术合伙人，他很看重项目周转率，对你的流程改进非常赞赏。
wk_raise_project_efficiency.task: 以降低成本和提升效率为切入点，申请业绩奖金。

tgt: I acknowledge the feedback on our related-party transaction testing; our sample coverage fell short of the 85% threshold.
We are currently scaling up the testing to address this gap, which will shift our completion date by 3 days.
I am confident that the additional work will bring our documentation up to standard.
traps: 避免说 'The team was too tired to finish'，这是借口，应说 'The initial sampling scope proved insufficient'。
避免说 'It’s not a big deal, just 3 days'，显得不负责，应说 'While this impacts our timeline, we are prioritizing quality to meet the standard'。
避免说 'We will do it again'，应使用 'We are revising the testing approach' 显得更有针对性。
wk_status_audit_rejection.ai: 项目合伙人，对于延期表示担忧，关注如何确保补做工作的质量。
wk_status_audit_rejection.task: 解释抽样不足的原因，并给出调整后的赶工方案。

tgt: Could you clarify the underlying business rationale for these intercompany cash transfers in 9M26?
Are there formal loan agreements in place, and what is the applicable interest rate?
What is the expected timeline for settling these outstanding balances prior to the transaction completion?
traps: 直译资金拆借为 'borrow money from each other'。完全是口语闲聊，专业说法是 'intercompany cash transfers' 或 'intercompany loans'。
直译业务背景为 'business background'。地道商务说法是 'business rationale'。
直译结平计划为 'clean plan'。搭配错误，应该用 'settling these outstanding balances' 或 'clearance timeline'。
dd_mgmt_intercompany.ai: Alex是标的公司资金主管。他解释这只是集团内部为了统筹资金使用进行的日常拆借，很快就会结平。
dd_mgmt_intercompany.task: 要求对方提供关联方资金拆借的底层协议、利率水平以及结平计划

tgt: The board approval for this capital expenditure was obtained after the contract execution.
This timing issue represents a deviation from the company’s capital expenditure policy.
We must document this as an internal control deficiency and track its rectification status.
traps: 不说 'You broke the rules' (直接对抗)，建议用 'The current practice deviated from the authorized approval workflow'。
不说 'This is not allowed' (太绝对)，建议用 'This sequence of events raises concerns regarding the enforcement of the policy'。
不说 'You need to be blamed for this' (人身攻击)，建议用 'We need to include this in our report for management’s follow-up'。
aud_ic_capex_approval.ai: Alex扮演项目负责人。他表示因为项目进度紧，为了拿地必须先签合同，董事会授权是补办的。
aud_ic_capex_approval.task: 指出程序违规风险，要求将其列入内控缺陷整改清单。

tgt: This annual software license fee of 180,000 HKD was fully expensed in December.
Should we allocate this amount across the 12-month subscription period?
Let's adjust the prepaid portion for the upcoming months.
traps: 说 'You shouldn't put it all in December' 显得外行，地道说法是 'was fully expensed in December'
把费用分摊说成 'split the money'，专业术语应为 'allocate this amount'
调整预付部分说成 'change the future money'，准确说法是 'adjust the prepaid portion'
aud_ic_software_license_expense.ai: Alex 是费用会计，他听完后回忆说这确实是一整年的订阅服务，同意按照月份进行跨期调整。
aud_ic_software_license_expense.task: 与费用会计确认软件年费的跨期分摊处理

tgt: Could you provide an update on the subsequent cash collection for the 5 million RMB rebate accrual?
What is the expected settlement timeline for the remaining 2 million RMB?
Have you assessed any collectibility risks for these outstanding rebates?
traps: 容易把期后回款说成 'after money back'，中式直译。地道财务英语是 'subsequent cash collection'。
容易说成 'When will the rest 2 million be paid?'，'the rest' 搭配数字略显口语化，用 'remaining 2 million' 更正式。
容易说成 'bad debt risk'，虽然能懂但尽调中评估款项收回风险通常用 'collectibility risks'。
dd_supp_audit_rebate_accrual.ai: Alex 是目标公司的财务经理。他态度平和，会解释这 500 万已经收回了 300 万，剩下 200 万预计在 2026 年 11 月到账。
dd_supp_audit_rebate_accrual.task: 确认 9M26 末 500 万元返利暂估的期后回款进度及坏账风险

tgt: We would like to schedule our interim review for the 9M26 results between Oct 12th and 14th.
I understand you have month-end closing procedures, so could we work around your busy period?
Are there specific time slots that would be less disruptive for your team?
traps: 说 'I need you to...'。语气太生硬，应使用 'Would it be possible to...'。
使用 'busy time'。应使用 'peak period' 或 'busy season'。
说 'interfere with your work'。用 'disruptive' 或 'impact' 更为专业。
aud_plan_confirm_interim_review.ai: Alex是客户会计经理，他表示这几天财务部人手紧张，建议能否错开结账日的头两天。
aud_plan_confirm_interim_review.task: 通过沟通协调出一个双方都能接受的时间窗口。

tgt: Could you review the FY25 management interview agenda and adjust related party transaction questions?
We need to add 2 more questions on intercompany sales pricing for FY25.
Please send the revised agenda to me by EOD today.
traps: 错误：Review agenda and adjust related party questions. 问题：related party是术语，正式场合需加限定词transaction，明确是关联交易，避免歧义。 地道：Adjust related party transaction questions.
错误：Add two more questions. 问题：数字表述口语化，正式场合需用2 more，更规范。 地道：Add 2 more questions on intercompany sales pricing.
错误：Send me revised agenda. 问题：缺少介词to，正式场合需用send to me，语法更准确。 地道：Send the revised agenda to me.
dd_mgmt_review_interview_agenda.ai: Alex是我方FDD项目 junior 同事，立场配合核对，诉求是明确需调整的关联交易追问点，避免遗漏。
dd_mgmt_review_interview_agenda.task: 同步需调整的追问点，确认议程定稿时间

tgt: I understand your concerns regarding the WHT exposure identified in the FY25 filing.
Our scope focused on standard statutory tax compliance; however, we recognize this specific transaction detail was missed during the initial review.
We are currently working with our tax specialists to draft a voluntary disclosure plan to minimize potential penalties for you.
traps: 使用'We didn't know about this'。听起来像推卸责任，应使用'This specific item fell outside the agreed scope of our initial review'。
使用'It is not a big deal'。轻视对方的合规焦虑，应使用'We acknowledge the gravity of this finding and prioritize a resolution'。
使用'You should have told us earlier'。这是典型的反唇相讥，应使用'Moving forward, we suggest establishing a direct line for such granular data updates'。
wk_client_overlooked_tax.ai: 客户税务经理。他感到被动，担心后续面临监管处罚，希望能确认项目组如何承担责任。
wk_client_overlooked_tax.task: 承认尽调边界，解释该项为何未列入初稿，并协同制定补救措施。

tgt: Under local contribution rules, annual performance bonuses paid in FY25 should typically be annualized and factored into the monthly social security base.
Even if past local bureau audits did not penalize this practice, the technical non-compliance remains a potential exposure for the acquirer.
Let's run a simulation to see the financial impact if we adjust the base to include the amortized annual bonus.
traps: Use 'Yearly bonus must be put into the monthly base'。语气过于生硬，地道说法应用 'annual performance bonuses should be annualized and factored into...'。
Use 'Even government didn't check before, it is still wrong'。'government didn't check before' 不够正式，应说 'past local bureau audits did not penalize this practice'。
Use 'Let's calculate how much money we will lose'。'lose' 表达不准确，评估财务影响应用 'evaluate the financial impact' 或 'quantify the financial exposure'。
dd_hr_annual_bonus_base.ai: Alex 是目标公司的财务经理。他认为年度奖金属于不定期激励，当地社保局在过往年度稽核时并未强制要求将其纳入月度平均工资基数。
dd_hr_annual_bonus_base.task: 指出按法规要求应将全年奖金平均计入社保基数，提示潜在的历史稽核补缴风险

tgt: Could you clarify the accounting treatment for this government grant?
Shouldn't the grant be offset against the carrying amount of the equipment?
Has the team assessed the tax implications of this capital expenditure?
traps: 说成'Why you didn't subtract the money?'，subtract是数学概念，会计应说offset或deduct。
说成'Is it capital-ized?'，不要自己创造动词，应说'Is this grant capitalized or recorded as income?'
说成'The government give us money for this'，give太口语，应说'The entity received a grant for this project'。
dd_capex_gov_grant.ai: Alex是财务总监，认为这是正常处理。他希望你确认这类补助处理是否需要进行账务调整。
dd_capex_gov_grant.task: 询问公司为何没有冲减资产原值，并确认补助性质

tgt: We’ve noted shipments to restricted regions in Q1 2026 without documented screening records.
Could you walk us through the internal control procedure for export compliance and sanctioned party screening?
Can you provide evidence that these counterparties were vetted against the relevant global watchlists?
traps: 使用 'You didn't check the blacklist'，太随意。应说 'Could you provide the screening protocols for these specific shipments?'。
使用 'This is dangerous'，太主观。应说 'This could trigger potential export control compliance issues'。
使用 'You need to give me the proof'，语气命令。应说 'Could you please provide the supporting documentation for these transactions?'。
dd_lic_export_control.ai: Alex是出口业务负责人，认为买家都是长期合作客户，没必要大张旗鼓地做筛查。
dd_lic_export_control.task: 指出缺乏筛查流程可能导致合规风险，并要求看合规记录。

tgt: Issuing an unexpected 150,000 USD extra bill without prior discussion will severely damage our relationship with the client's CFO.
We should schedule a meeting to walk them through the additional 300 hours caused by the European acquisition before sending the invoice.
Let's propose a capped fee structure or phase the extra charges to maintain a good commercial partnership.
traps: 中国人常说 "If we send this bill directly, the client will be very angry"，不够职业。地道说法是 "Issuing an unexpected extra bill without prior discussion will damage our relationship."
中国人常说 "We need to talk with them first to explain why we spent 300 hours"，句式散乱。地道说法是 "We should schedule a meeting to walk them through the additional hours."
中国人常说 "We can give them some discount"，表达不够正式。地道说法是 "Let's propose a capped fee structure or phase the extra charges."
wk_conf_audit_fee_dispute.ai: Alex 扮演合伙人助理。他认为额外工作量完全超出了原定 engagement letter 的范围，按工时收费天经地义，不应该主动替客户省钱。
wk_conf_audit_fee_dispute.task: 平衡商业关系与成本回收，主张先与客户财务总监进行沟通谈判再确定额外收费金额。

tgt: We observed that slow-moving inventory with an aging over one year reaches 8 million RMB in 9M26.
Could you help explain the basis for the current provision rate applied to these aged items?
Could you provide the detailed aging report and any upcoming disposal plans for these materials?
traps: 说成 'Your provision is too low.' 带有批判性。地道表达应用 'Could you help explain the basis for the current provision rate?'
使用 'You have too much dead stock.' 显得不够职业。地道表达应用 'We observed slow-moving inventory reaching 8 million RMB.'
说成 'I want the disposal plan.' 过于直接。地道请求应用 'Could you please provide the detailed aging report and disposal plans?'
dd_vdr_inventories_obs.ai: Eric 是仓库主管。他认为这些呆滞物料未来还有翻新利用的可能，对大比例计提跌价准备有抵触情绪，但愿意提供详细的库龄明细表协助分析。
dd_vdr_inventories_obs.task: 要求对方提供库龄超过 1 年的呆滞物料明细及近期处置计划

tgt: There's a contradiction between the legal status of the entity and the FY25 financial reporting.
We need to ensure that the revenue and expenses are correctly attributed to the successor entity rather than the dissolved one.
Could you provide a breakdown of how the post-liquidation transactions were recorded in the books?
traps: 使用 'The name is wrong'，应使用 'There is a discrepancy in the reporting entity'。
使用 'The company is dead'，应使用 'The entity has been legally dissolved'。
使用 'Fix the mistake'，应使用 'We need to rectify the accounting records to reflect the correct legal entity'。
dd_sub_entity_legal_status.ai: Alex是客户法务顾问。他承认那是沟通失误，但认为这只是名字搞错了，实际业务是新公司在做。
dd_sub_entity_legal_status.task: 要求对方厘清法律主体与实际经营主体，并对财务账套进行更名或清理。

tgt: We're in a bind due to the unexpected departure. Could we expedite the hiring process for a temporary contractor?
If the full process takes too long, can we use an external agency to fill the role temporarily?
Is there any possibility of transferring someone from another department on a short-term basis?
traps: 说 'We need someone now' 太急切，应该说 'We have an urgent need for additional support.'
说 'Can't you just hire quickly?' 听起来指责，应该说 'Is there any way to streamline the hiring timeline?'
说 'It's your job' 太粗鲁，应该说 'I'm relying on your expertise to find a solution.'
wk_res_human_resources_for_recruitment.ai: Alex 是人力资源主管，负责招聘流程。他理解紧急程度，但需要遵循公司的招聘政策，同时寻找灵活解决方案，如使用外部中介或加速内部调动。
wk_res_human_resources_for_recruitment.task: 与 Alex 协商，找到加速招聘的途径，确保在结账前有人手支持。

tgt: I noticed the warranty provision rate dropped from 3% in FY24 to 1% in FY25. What drove this change?
Could you share the historical warranty claim data for the past three years to support this adjustment?
How does the engineering team estimate the potential future repair costs for products sold in 9M26?
traps: 使用 'Why did you cut the warranty money down?' 带有审讯语气且不够专业，应说 'What drove the change in the warranty provision rate?'
使用 'Give me the past repair numbers' 语气生硬，商务沟通应用 'Could you share the historical warranty claim data?'
使用 'How do you guess future repair cost?' 动词用错，估算未来成本应使用 'estimate potential future repair costs'
dd_cont_product_warranty_provision.ai: Alex 是目标公司的财务经理。他认可你的专业提问，并准备了解释该比例调整的历史售后维修数据支持。
dd_cont_product_warranty_provision.task: 了解质保金计提比例下调的依据及历史实际赔付率

tgt: Sending a balance confirmation is a standard procedure for financial due diligence.
This will help us reconcile our records and ensure both parties are aligned.
We can phrase the letter to emphasize it’s for audit compliance rather than a dispute.
traps: 使用 'Don't worry, it's just a routine'，routine 作名词不对。应说 'It's a standard procedure'。
使用 'The supplier will be angry'，太情绪化。应说 'We want to maintain a constructive relationship with the vendor'。
使用 'We have to do it'，语气太生硬。应说 'As part of our standard diligence protocol, we need to verify the outstanding balance'。
dd_supp_rebate_confirmation.ai: 采购经理，担心直接发函会显得公司在怀疑供应商，影响后续合作关系。
dd_supp_rebate_confirmation.task: 说明发函是标准的尽调审计流程，旨在规避潜在的对账误差。

tgt: The revenue cutoff testing is incorrect because control of the goods didn't transfer until October.
We must align the revenue recognition with the actual customs clearance date, not the dispatch date.
Please re-perform the cutoff test for these late-September shipments using the signed delivery notes.
traps: 使用 'The revenue test time is wrong'，'time' 无法准确表达财务中的 'cutoff' 概念，应直接用 'cutoff testing'。
使用 'We need to match revenue with customs date'，搭配略显生硬，地道商务表达为 'align the revenue recognition with'。
使用 'Please redo the test again'，'redo' 和 'again' 语义重复，属于典型的中国式英语冗余。
wk_fb_revenue_cutoff.ai: Alex 扮演审计经办。他认为货物在 9 月底已经发出离港，符合收入确认的合同条款，不理解为什么非要按签收日划分。
wk_fb_revenue_cutoff.task: 向 Alex 澄清风险控制节点，说明国际货物运输必须以客户签收或报关完成为准，要求其重新调整截止性测试底稿。

tgt: We noticed a change in the payment terms for your major suppliers in FY26. Was this change driven by cash flow management considerations?
Have the suppliers formally agreed to these extended payment terms without any adjustments to the unit price?
Does the company anticipate any potential supply chain disruption due to these revised terms?
traps: 使用 'Are you running out of cash?'，应改为 'Is the extended term related to the company's current liquidity position?'，前者直接质疑偿债能力，容易引起反感。
使用 'The suppliers might be unhappy'，应改为 'Are there any concerns regarding potential supplier relationship issues?'，前者过于口语，后者更具专业性。
使用 'You didn't pay them'，应改为 'There is an extension in payment terms'，前者指责意味重，后者陈述事实。
aud_gc_supplier_credit_terms.ai: 客户采购经理，解释这是为了优化现金管理，并非因为付不起钱，供应商也都同意了。
aud_gc_supplier_credit_terms.task: 了解账期延长背后的商业动因及客户流动性状况。

tgt: Sales rebates granted to your top three customers surged to 15% of total revenue in FY25. Could you walk us through the tier structure of these rebates?
Were all these volume-based incentives fully accrued by the end of the FY25 reporting period?
How does this level of price concession impact your net realized margins compared to the gross figures?
traps: 说成 'You gave too much discounts to big clients.'。'much discounts' 语法错误且用词不准，应为 'such substantial sales rebates' 或 'discounts'（不可数或用 concessions）。
说成 'Did you write down all these money in FY25?'。'write down' 意思混淆，财务计提应使用 'accrued' 或 'recorded provisions'。
说成 'Does this make your real profit much lower?'。'real profit much lower' 表达不够学术，应说 'impact your net realized margins'。
dd_cust_rebate_and_discount.ai: 标公司财务总监 Linda。她说明这是为了抢占市场份额而给予的年度阶梯式返利，所有计提均已在FY25期末完成。
dd_cust_rebate_and_discount.task: 确认大客户高额销售返利的计算依据、计提准确性及其对真实毛利率的侵蚀程度

tgt: We identified a 5% equity pledge that doesn't appear to be reflected in the FY25 financial disclosures.
Given the impact on share liquidity, we need to verify if this pledge has been formally released.
Are there any other encumbrances on the major shareholders' equity that we should be aware of?
traps: 常说 'This is a big hidden bomb'，中式修辞过于夸张。应使用 'This represents a significant disclosure risk'。
常说 'You hid this from us'，指责语气过重。应说 'It appears this information was not captured in the previous disclosure'。
常说 'The shares are locked'，不准确。应使用 'The shares are subject to an encumbrance' 或 'The shares were pledged'。
dd_equity_unauthorized_pledge.ai: Alex是公司法务，他觉得这属于大股东个人行为，与公司运营无关，没必要大惊小怪。
dd_equity_unauthorized_pledge.task: 强调该事项对股权稳定性及上市合规的影响，要求提供解除质押的相关证明

tgt: We’ve noted payments to non-financial institutions categorized as miscellaneous fees.
Could you provide the breakdown of these charges and the associated service agreements?
We need to reconcile these payments with our assessment of the company’s borrowing costs.
traps: 常说 'This looks like interest to me'，不要随意做判断；应使用 'We need to reconcile these payments with our borrowing cost assessment'。
常说 'The service fees are fake'，太主观；应使用 'Could you provide the service agreements for these fees?'
常说 'You are paying high interest'，语气指控；应使用 'We have observed payments to non-financial institutions'。
dd_cash_interest_off_book.ai: Alex 是合规主管，他试图掩盖这笔支出，称其为零星杂费。
dd_cash_interest_off_book.task: 要求提供该‘手续费’的具体服务合同及收款方证明，并指出其与公司借贷规模的关联性。

tgt: This response is clearly an exception, not a confirmation of our records.
We must treat this as a red flag and initiate alternative procedures immediately.
Do not file this as an 'agreed' response; it requires further investigation.
traps: 使用 'Put this into the file as okay'，非常口语化。应使用 'Document this as an exception in the audit file.'
错用 'Maybe they are wrong'，应使用 'The response indicates a potential discrepancy that warrants further inquiry.'
说成 'Wait for a minute, don't do that'，不够简洁，应用 'Hold on, we need to re-evaluate the treatment of this response.'
aud_conf_negative_reply.ai: 项目组审计员Alex。他觉得这可能只是零售商记错了，想直接把这封回函当作‘无异议’归档。
aud_conf_negative_reply.task: 叫停Alex的行为，要求将其升级为例外事项，并安排执行替代程序。

tgt: I cannot thank you enough for nailing that indemnification clause under such intense time pressure.
Your flawless alignment with our financial adjustments made this cross-border settlement go through smoothly.
It was absolute teamwork how your legal team and our financial team closed every loophole before the submission.
traps: 说成 'Thank you for writing the contract'，太基础。地道表达应用 'I cannot thank you enough for nailing that indemnification clause.'
说成 'Your law matches our money data well'，词汇混乱。地道表达应用 'Your alignment with our financial adjustments made it go smoothly.'
说成 'We worked together very well'，小学生表达。地道表达应用 'It was absolute teamwork how your legal and our financial teams closed every loophole.'
wk_praise_legal_counsel_kudos.ai: Alex 扮演外部律所合伙人 Alex。他刚发来定稿文件，准备跟你交接后续的法律合规跟踪事宜。
wk_praise_legal_counsel_kudos.task: 感谢法务团队在法律条款与财务赔偿机制对接上的无缝配合，凸显双方合作的默契。

tgt: Is there a dispute regarding the royalty rates for the extended use of the licensed technology?
We need to quantify the accrued liability for the unpaid license fees since the expiration date.
Does the existing agreement stipulate any penalty clauses for continued usage without a formal extension?
traps: 搭配错误：说 'The contract is broken'。应说 'The contract has been breached'。
词汇贫乏：说 'They are mad at us'。应说 'They are contesting the usage terms'。
语法错误：说 'We have not pay them'。应说 'We have not paid the outstanding license fees'。
dd_cont_license_royalty.ai: Alex是法务合规经理。他认为正在与对方谈判，对方暂时不会起诉。
dd_cont_license_royalty.task: 确认未付费用的具体金额及合同违约金条款，判断潜在赔偿风险。

tgt: This adjustment is purely a reclassification under HKFRS 16, so your core operating cash flows remain completely unaffected.
We can include an explanatory note in the financial statements to clarify this ratio shift for your banking syndicate.
Let's walk through how the right-of-use asset and lease liability are recognized on the balance sheet for these twelve retail stores.
traps: 使用 'this change will not influence your cash'。influence 通常指潜移默化的影响，此处指实质影响应用 affect。
使用 'we can write a note in report'。report 过于口语且泛指，正式专业服务中应说 financial statements 或 notes to the accounts。
使用 'let us look at how the asset is build up'。build up 搭配不当，资产的确认和计量应用 recognize 和 measure。
aud_hkfrs_lease_transition.ai: David，博远实业财务总监。他很配合，只是对报表指标恶化有顾虑，希望你用通俗的语言解释这只是会计口径变化而非实质负债增加。
aud_hkfrs_lease_transition.task: 向客户清晰解释 HKFRS 16 租赁修订对报表指标的重分类影响，消除其对银行授信的担忧

tgt: Under HKAS 23, borrowing costs must be suspended during extended periods of abnormal construction interruption.
Could you provide the daily site log for Q2 to help us pinpoint the exact suspension period?
The interest expense incurred during these three months should be expensed directly to the income statement.
traps: 使用 'borrowing fee'。在审计准则中，借款产生的费用统称为 borrowing costs 而不是 fee。
使用 'stop to capitalize the interest'。stop to do 表示停下来去做别的事，停止做某事应用 stop capitalizing。
使用 'put the interest into profit and loss directly'。put 显得随意，正式表述应用 charge/expense to the income statement 或 profit or loss。
aud_hkfrs_borrowing_costs.ai: Kevin，凯旋置业财务经理。他知道工程中断了，手头备好了施工日志，正主动帮你界定符合资本化的具体月份。
aud_hkfrs_borrowing_costs.task: 依据 HKAS 23 厘清非正常中断期间利息费用停止资本化的金额与账务处理

tgt: There's a discrepancy between the legal list and the accounting provision, and we need clarity to ensure the provision is fairly stated.
Could we set up a quick call with both the finance and legal teams to reconcile these figures?
To satisfy the audit requirements, we need a consistent explanation from both departments.
traps: Avoid 'You are wrong about the amount'. Better: 'There appears to be a reconciliation difference between the two sources.'
Avoid 'Tell me who is lying'. Too aggressive. Better: 'Could you help us understand the basis for this difference?'
Avoid 'I don't care about the legal contract'. Better: 'My focus is on ensuring the financial reporting is consistent with the legal position.'
aud_plan_legal_acc_discrepancy.ai: 客户法务总监，认为财务部未正确理解合同条款，且拒绝提供进一步的法律意见书。
aud_plan_legal_acc_discrepancy.task: 促成财务与法务部门坐下来沟通，确保审计证据（准备金计提）的准确性。

tgt: The acquisition agreement includes an earn-out clause based on three-year sales targets, which hasn't been recognized as a contingent consideration liability.
How was the fair value of this earn-out estimated at the acquisition date?
Should we record a retrospective adjustment to account for this financial liability under the current framework?
traps: 说成 'The contract has a bonus money part based on future sales, but you didn't write it as debt.'，口语化严重。地道表达应用 'includes an earn-out clause... hasn't been recognized as a contingent consideration liability'
说成 'How did you guess the fair value?'，'guess' 不专业。地道表达应用 'How was the fair value of this earn-out estimated'
说成 'Do we need to change back things?'，意思模糊。地道表达应用 'record a retrospective adjustment to account for this financial liability'
dd_ia_contingent_consideration.ai: Alex 扮演买方财务总监。他当时主要从业务角度主导了交易结构设计，正和你一起梳理该或有对价在准则下的合规入账方式。
dd_ia_contingent_consideration.task: 指出或有对价未确认为金融负债的会计处理瑕疵，并要求计算其公允价值

tgt: Focus on how the loan agreement defines 'Adjusted EBITDA' specifically.
You need to bridge the gap between the statutory financials and the bank's covenant calculations.
Take a moment to cross-reference the debt schedule with the latest compliance report.
traps: 说 'You look at the contract'，更地道应为 'Focus on the definition in the agreement'。
说 'Calculate the money'，应为 'Calculate the financial covenants'。
说 'Make the gap smaller'，应为 'Bridge the gap'。
wk_train_covenants_check.ai: 初级分析师，他对财务模型中的调整项存疑，担心算错会导致违约判定失误。
wk_train_covenants_check.task: 带他过一遍 EBITDA 的调整逻辑，强调合同解释与财务报表的关联。

tgt: We need to derecognize the net assets of the disposed subsidiary on the date control is lost.
The remaining 15% equity interest must be remeasured at fair value.
The resulting gain on disposal should be properly presented in the consolidated P&L.
traps: 把终止确认说成 'stop recognition'。正确的准则专业术语是 'derecognition'。
把重新计量说成 'measure again'。专业表达是 'remeasure' 或 'remeasurement'。
把处置损益说成 'dispose profit'。地道说法是 'gain/loss on disposal'。
aud_consol_disposal_subsidiary.ai: Alex 是集团财务副总裁。他希望能合法合规地最大化当期投资收益，正向你咨询丧失控制权当天的会计处理依据。
aud_consol_disposal_subsidiary.task: 向集团财务解释丧失控制权当日子公司损益出表及剩余股权按公允价值计量的准则要求。

tgt: We observed an inconsistency in the translation method applied to the overseas trade receivables and their corresponding provision as of 9M26.
Since the bad debt provision is a contra-asset account, it should be translated at the month-end spot rate alongside the gross receivable.
Could you help adjust the allowance schedule to align with the standard balance sheet translation guidelines?
traps: 把坏账准备直译为 'bad debt prepare' 是严重中式错误，标准财务术语是 'bad debt provision' 或 'allowance for doubtful accounts'。
说备抵科目用 'against asset' 不规范，标准说法是 'contra-asset account'。
要求调整表格说 'change the table' 过于随意，商务口语应用 'adjust the allowance schedule'。
dd_fx_overseas_subsidiary_bad_debt_fx.ai: Alex 是海外子公司的财务负责人。他表示由于系统限制，坏账准备一直沿用计提时点的汇率进行期末报表勾稽。
dd_fx_overseas_subsidiary_bad_debt_fx.task: 指出坏账准备作为资产备抵项目，期末折算汇率应当与对应的应收账款原值保持一致，即均采用月末即期汇率。

tgt: I recognize the quality concerns, but the client’s transaction timeline has been strictly accelerated.
If we focus our scope on high-risk jurisdictions only, do you believe we can meet the 10-day target?
We need to balance the depth of the review with the client's current requirement for a fast-tracked summary report.
traps: 使用 'Just do it faster'，显得不专业且漠视风险，应说 'Can we streamline the workflow to meet the deadline?'
使用 'I think it's okay'，显得判断随意，应说 'We need to assess if this approach remains risk-adjusted'。
使用 'No problem to do it'，承诺过度，应说 'We will do our best to accommodate the timeline under these constraints'。
wk_dl_tax_urgency.ai: 税务合伙人，他非常看重项目质量，担心缩短时间会导致漏掉关键的增值税税务风险，对此非常抵触。
wk_dl_tax_urgency.task: 在不牺牲基本风险覆盖的前提下，说服对方通过采用抽样测试法接受更紧凑的时间表。

tgt: A verbal confirmation won't suffice for our documentation; we need the supporting reconciliation statement.
Could you provide the intercompany breakdown as of the end of 9M26 to justify this variance?
To clear this audit trail, we need to verify the specific entries that constitute the 15 million gap.
traps: 避免说 'You should give me the detail'，使用 'Could you provide' 才是标准职场礼貌。
不要用 'It is a mistake in your system'，这显得你在指责对方，应说 'There seems to be an unresolved variance in the system'。
避免说 'I don't believe you'，应说 'We need to substantiate this figure with supporting documents'。
dd_scope_intercompany_reconciliation.ai: Alex是对方财务经理。他正在忙于季报结账，认为你查得过细，试图用流程理由搪塞，想让你接受口头说明。
dd_scope_intercompany_reconciliation.task: 坚持要求获取对账单，并解释为何口头确认无法作为审计底稿

tgt: We propose rolling out barcode and RFID tags for our fixed asset inventory.
The new method will shorten the physical count cycle from three weeks to five days.
It will also help us significantly lower the discrepancy rate below 1%.
traps: 词汇混淆：说成 'things we own' 代替固定资产。财税英语中必须用 'fixed assets' 或 'property, plant and equipment'。
介词搭配错误：说成 'reduce the rate under 1%'。低于某个百分比应用 'below 1%' 或 'to under 1%'，漏掉 'to' 或误用介词会显得不自然。
句式啰嗦：说成 'This can help to make the count faster'。口语或书面中直接用 'will shorten the count cycle' 更加干练。
wk_proc_05_fixed_assets.ai: Alex 是财务资产管理负责人。他对去年的清点效率也很头疼，正寻求更高效的盘点方式。
wk_proc_05_fixed_assets.task: 说服 Alex 在 FY26 全面推行条码与 RFID 资产标签盘点，以缩短盘点周期。

tgt: Could you provide the historical data on returns for these specific contracts to help us evaluate the revenue recognition policy?
Given the right of return clause, how does your accounting policy align with the current revenue recognition standards?
Could you walk us through the internal control process for recording returns associated with these contracts?
traps: 使用 'You shouldn't record the revenue'，直接否定客户财务政策。应改为 'We are evaluating the accounting treatment for these contracts; could you clarify the rationale behind this policy?'
使用 'This is against the rules'，显得傲慢。应改为 'We are reviewing the compliance with the revenue recognition standards given the contract terms.'
使用 'The return rate is not relevant'，直接反驳对方观点。应改为 'While the historical return rate is low, we need to consider the impact of the clause itself on the timing of revenue recognition.'
dd_mgmt_revenue_recognition.ai: Alex是销售副总裁。他认为这是行业惯例，且历史退货率极低，无需调整收入确认时点。
dd_mgmt_revenue_recognition.task: 要求调取近三年的退货数据，并评估该条款对收入确认合规性的影响。

tgt: We stratified the FY25 receivable balances into three distinct risk tiers, applying 100% testing to balances over one million.
For the remaining medium-risk stratum, we applied monetary unit sampling to ensure high-value items had a proportionally higher selection probability.
This stratification approach aligns with our risk assessment and ensures we cover at least 85 percent of the total carrying amount.
traps: 搭配错误：说成 'cut the receivable into groups'。地道说法是 'stratify the accounts receivable into tiers/strata'。
介词误用：说成 'sample for the middle risk stratum'。'sample' 作为动词直接跟宾语，不用加介词 'for'。
发音混淆导致拼写直译：把分层抽样写成 'layer sampling'。标准的审计专业术语是 'stratified sampling'。
aud_samp_ar_aging_stratification.ai: Sarah，审计项目合伙人。她态度专业温和，要求确保分层抽样方案能够覆盖潜在的坏账风险敞口。
aud_samp_ar_aging_stratification.task: 向合伙人汇报并辩护对应收账款实施分层抽样及对高风险账龄全额覆盖的合理性

tgt: My apologies, I accidentally sent you version two instead of the finalized version three.
The draft version contained some internal working notes that are no longer applicable.
I've just resent the clean final balance sheet to your inbox.
traps: 不要说 'I sent the wrong file by mistake.'，虽然没错但表达略显单薄，地道说法用 'accidentally attached an outdated draft'。
不要说 'Please delete the old one.'，命令式语气不太礼貌，应用 'Please disregard the previous version'。
不要说 'The notes inside are just for fun.'，听起来很不专业，应用 'internal working notes that are no longer applicable'。
wk_sorry_wrong_version.ai: Alex 是合作银行的信贷审核专员。他看到报表上有内部讨论批注觉得奇怪，找你确认哪份是最终版。
wk_sorry_wrong_version.task: 澄清版本错误，立即发送终稿并解释差异

tgt: Please provide the technical acceptance report for the HK$450k office equipment purchase.
We need a 5-day deadline to retrieve and submit the missing technical document.
Let’s add ‘technical acceptance report’ to the mandatory documents for fixed asset purchases over HK$300k.
traps: 中国人常说「you didn’t get the right paper」，口语化，地道表达为「the required technical acceptance documentation is missing from the purchase file」，前者不专业，后者正式。
中国人常说「tech team had it」，表述笼统，地道表达为「the technical team’s acceptance form is stored in their project folder」，前者无细节，后者更具体。
中国人常说「give it to me now」，急躁感强，地道表达为「could we confirm a timeline to obtain the document and submit it」，前者不礼貌，后者更得体。
aud_ic_fy24_fixed_asset_accept.ai: Alex扮演客户采购专员，立场是技术部已验收但未归档，愿意调取报告，而非遗漏。
aud_ic_fy24_fixed_asset_accept.task: 提交技术验收报告的时限，同步升级内控要求大额固定资产附技术验收。

tgt: The tightening regulatory landscape since FY25 has really shifted how we approach risk assessment.
From your perspective, how have the recent policy changes affected the audit readiness for cross-border clients?
I'd appreciate it if we could keep each other updated on these regulatory shifts.
traps: 问“What are you doing about the new regulation?”，太私人化，应使用“What is the prevailing market sentiment regarding these new regulations?”
说“Tell me your opinion”，不够礼貌，应使用“I'd be interested to hear your take on the impact of this policy.”
说“You know better than me”，过于卑微，应使用“Your expertise in this legal area is well-recognized.”
wk_net_legal_cross_check.ai: Alex 是法律合伙人，他很谨慎，他愿意交流行业观察，但绝不会透露具体客户信息。
wk_net_legal_cross_check.task: 引导对方分享对特定监管政策的解读，并建立行业信息互通渠道

tgt: We observed that some administrative depreciation and sales staff travel expenses have been included in the FY25 R&D expense pool.
Since these costs are not directly attributable to qualifying research activities, we need a clear allocation basis or time-sheet record.
Could you adjust the R&D schedule to exclude these non-qualifying expenses before we perform our tax compliance review?
traps: 不要说 'You put the wrong money into R&D'，'put the wrong money' 极其口语化，应用 'have been included in the R&D expense pool'。
不要说 'These are not for R&D, you should take them out'，'take them out' 缺乏专业度，应用 'exclude these non-qualifying expenses'。
不要说 'We need to see who worked how long'，表达过于繁琐，应用 'we need a clear allocation basis or time-sheet record'。
aud_mgmt_rd_expense.ai: Alex，客户公司的财务经理。他解释说这些人员和办公场地偶尔也会为研发项目提供后勤支持，所以当时在费用分配时做了部分归集。
aud_mgmt_rd_expense.task: 指出行政与销售费用不能混入研发支出，要求客户提供清晰的工时记录和场地使用面积分摊明细以剔除无关费用。

tgt: The leverage ratio spike to 3.8x is an anomaly driven by one-off restructuring costs in FY25.
We are requesting a temporary covenant waiver for this quarter without a corresponding margin increase.
To mitigate your credit concerns, we can provide an updated FY26F cash flow forecast by next Friday.
traps: 解释违约时常说 'This is not our fault, it is because of restructing.'，语气像在抱怨。地道说法是 'This variance is primarily driven by non-recurring restructuring charges.'
谈豁免时常说 'Forgive us this time.'，用词像请求原谅。地道说法是 'We are seeking a formal covenant waiver for this reporting period.'
谈利率时常说 'increase price of loan'，不专业。地道说法是 'A corresponding margin increase or basis point adjustment.'
wk_neg_bank_covenant_waiver.ai: Alex 扮演银行高级客户经理。他表示信贷委员会对杠杆率指标非常敏感，要求提高 0.5% 的贷款利率作为豁免交换条件，或者追加短期保证金。
wk_neg_bank_covenant_waiver.task: 争取以提供 FY26F 盈利预测更新为条件，免除本次违约处罚且不提高贷款利率。

tgt: We acknowledge the gap in scope regarding tier-two suppliers in our initial FY25 report.
The primary challenge was the lack of standardized data collection protocols among overseas suppliers.
We have developed a supplementary template to capture this missing data for the upcoming review.
traps: 不要说 'The data is hard to get'，不够职业，应说 'Data acquisition from sub-tier suppliers posed significant challenges'.
不要用 'We forgot to add it'，这显得极不专业，应说 'This aspect was outside the initial scope of the engagement'.
不要说 'We can solve this problem very fast'，容易承诺过度，应说 'We are prioritizing the remediation of this reporting gap'.
wk_self_esg_reporting_gap.ai: 客户CFO，他关心企业的融资信誉，因为披露缺失而感到焦虑，希望了解团队如何弥补这一漏洞。
wk_self_esg_reporting_gap.task: 承认工作缺口，解释为何当时数据获取不可行，并提出补救方案。

tgt: Good morning. I’m the project manager from [Firm Name], overseeing our client’s cross-border tax compliance.
We are here to seek clarification on the new regulatory updates effective from FY26.
I have our firm’s authorization letter and the project brief for your reference.
traps: 不要说 'I am here for tax thing.'，'thing' 太随便，应说 'I am here regarding tax compliance matters.'。
避免 'I tell you who I am.'，语气太生硬，应说 'Allow me to introduce myself and our firm.'。
不要说 'I represent the office.'，应说 'I am representing my firm.'。
wk_intro_tax_bureau.ai: Alex 是税务局的工作人员，他需要核实你的团队是否具有正规的咨询机构背景，而非无关人员。
wk_intro_tax_bureau.task: 清晰阐述身份与机构背景，表达来意。

tgt: I'm calling to report a confidential data mishandling incident regarding our 9M26 working papers.
An analyst inadvertently transmitted a file containing sensitive supply chain data to an unauthorized third party, but we have already secured a signed deletion confirmation from them.
We are conducting an internal audit of our secure transfer protocols to ensure this never happens again.
traps: 说成 "Our staff sent your secret file to a wrong person"，'secret file' 和 'wrong person' 显得毫无合规意识，专业说法是 'confidential data mishandling incident' 和 'unauthorized third party'。
说成 "The other guy already deleted it, so it's safe"，'The other guy' 极不正式，应称作 'an unauthorized third party' 且强调 'secured a signed deletion confirmation'。
说成 "We promise we won't make this stupid mistake again"，使用 'stupid mistake' 过于贬低自己团队，职场整改承诺应用 'conducting an internal audit of our secure transfer protocols'。
wk_bad_leak_confidential_data.ai: Alex 是客户公司的法务合伙人兼合规官，听到商业机密外泄后，他需要立刻评估这是否违反了双方签署的保密协议（NDA），以及对方是否保留了备份。
wk_bad_leak_confidential_data.task: 向客户法务合伙人坦诚通报误发事件的经过、补救措施（已确认销毁），以及内部整改方案。

tgt: You are entirely right that the new production line introduces variables not captured in the three-year historical average.
We will incorporate your operational yield data into the warranty provision model right away.
