使用 "You must come to your birthday dinner." 语气像下命令。地道表达是 "You definitely can't miss your own birthday dinner!"
soc_invite_thai_food_birthday.ai: Alex 扮演好朋友 Leo。他假装自己周六已经有别的约会了，想逗逗你，需要你用真诚的话语把他“骗”出来。
soc_invite_thai_food_birthday.task: 识破并化解 Leo 的假推脱，确认他周六晚上的时间。

tgt: Oh wow, I'm so sorry! From that angle, you look identical to a regular here.
I totally thought you were my friend Chris. My apologies!
Enjoy your coffee.
traps: 说成 'Your face is like my friend.'。比较中式，地道说法是 'You look just like a friend of mine' 或 'You have a facial resemblance to...'。
说成 'I call the wrong name.'。动词搭配不对，叫错名字应该说 'I called you by the wrong name' 或 'I got your name wrong'。
说成 'Hope you don't mind my mistake.'。虽然客气但略显啰嗦，直接说 'Sorry about that!' 更自然。
soc_name_coffee_shop.ai: Alex 扮演排在你前面的顾客。他温和地笑着说自己不叫 Chris，也不是常客。
soc_name_coffee_shop.task: 向对方道歉，解释因为侧脸和常客很像而认错人。

tgt: Excuse me, would it be possible to switch to another seat?
The person next to me is eating something quite strong, and I'm a bit sensitive to smells.
Could you check if there are any empty rows further back?
traps: 错用“Can I change my seat?”：虽然语法对，但显得太直接。地道说法是用“Would it be possible to...”。
错用“I have a problem with him”：这听起来像人身攻击。应说“I'm a bit sensitive to the smell”，把焦点放在客观情况上。
错用“Give me another seat”：祈使句显得像在发号施令，极其不礼貌。应使用“Could you...”开头。
soc_favor_flight_seat.ai: 你是空乘，友善且乐于助人。只要后排座位没被预留，你会很愿意帮你调整。
soc_favor_flight_seat.task: 询问是否有空位并请求更换

tgt: Tom, you cannot leave all the broccoli on the side of your plate; you need to eat at least half of them.
Vegetables give your body the vitamins and energy it needs to grow taller and run faster during soccer practice.
If you finish these up without making a fuss, you can have a small bowl of yogurt for dessert.
traps: “把菜拨到旁边”直译为 move the vegetables to side 很生硬，地道表达是 leave the broccoli on the side of your plate。
“大个子、跑得快”如果说 grow up big and fast 会显得中式，地道说法是 grow taller and run faster。
“如果不吵闹/不抱怨”如果说 without making trouble 会显得太严重，对孩子用 without making a fuss（不抱怨、不闹情绪）更贴切。
soc_parent_vegetable_refusal.ai: Alex 扮演儿子 Tom，坚决抵触绿叶蔬菜，认为大人在强迫他吃难吃的东西，试图用“我已经吃饱了”来逃避。
soc_parent_vegetable_refusal.task: 让孩子至少把盘子里的西兰花吃掉一半，并讲道理让他明白营养均衡的重要性

tgt: I see the issue; the soft top is slightly flexible, may I try to press it down?
Is there any extra space under the adjacent seat, or can I rearrange my items?
I want to make sure it's safe; how much clearance is strictly required?
traps: 不要说 'It's fine, nobody cares'，这会激怒空乘，应用 'I want to comply with the safety regulations'。
不要说 'My dog will be sad if I move him'，这是情感诉求而非合规讨论，重点应放在 'soft-sided carrier flexibility'。
不要直接争辩，应用 'I understand the safety protocol, can we try adjusting it together?'。
talk_pet_plane_crate.ai: Alex 是空乘，他不仅考虑你的方便，更要确保飞行安全和合规，必须严格执行空间规范。
talk_pet_plane_crate.task: 协商解决方案，询问是否可以调整位置或尝试压低航空箱的软质部分。

tgt: I love that song! It's one of my favorites.
Using songs to learn is a great idea. I'm actually doing the same with English songs.
Maybe next time we're waiting for our laundry, we can help each other with the lyrics?
traps: 说 'Learning from songs is good' 太简单。说 'Using songs is such a creative way to learn'。
说 'We help each other' 缺少目的。说 'We could help each other understand the meanings'。
说 'I like your song' 语气有点像在评价物品。说 'That's a great song'。
hob_lang_laundry_chat.ai: Alex 是个留学生，非常喜欢中文歌，觉得这比课本更有趣。
hob_lang_laundry_chat.task: 赞同他的方法，并提出我们可以互换一下歌曲，顺便练习。

tgt: I'm really sorry about your night, but I can't have anyone over tonight.
I have an early start tomorrow morning and need my rest.
You might want to check with the 24-hour lounge downstairs or call a friend.
traps: 使用 'I am inconvenient tonight' 来表示不方便，直译自中文 '我今晚不方便'，但在英语中 'inconvenient' 通常形容事物而不是人，应说 'I am not available' 或 'It's not a good time'.
使用 'You cannot live in my home' 语气过于激烈，像是在驱逐房客，拒绝借宿用 'stay over' 或 'stay for the night' 更自然。
使用 'I have personal things to do tomorrow' 显得借口很假，用 'I have an early start' 或 'I have a busy day ahead' 作为不便留宿的理由更符合英语习惯。
soc_bound_neighbor_noise.ai: Alex 是隔壁邻居，因为刚跟室友大吵一架情绪有点激动，希望能在你家借住一晚，他会试图让你同情他的处境。
soc_bound_neighbor_noise.task: 温和但坚定地拒绝对方借宿，并建议他去找其他地方

tgt: Patel, I'm heading out of the neighborhood for good tomorrow.
I still have 18 dollars on this laundry card, do you mind if I leave it for someone who needs it?
It's been great seeing you every Tuesday morning.
traps: 说成 'I leave my card to you' 介词用错，应该说 'leave it with you' 或 'leave it for someone'。
表达离开这个街区说 'leave the community' 有点严肃，日常说 'moving out of the neighborhood' 更贴切。
说 'We met every Tuesday' 听起来像约会，熟人日常打交道用 'It's been great seeing you'。
soc_farewell_laundry_owner.ai: Patel 记性很好，笑着说会把这 18 美元折现退给你，或者你可以留给下一位客人。他祝你一路顺风。
soc_farewell_laundry_owner.task: 处理洗衣卡余额并向 Patel 道别

tgt: Look, there's a deep scratch here on the edge of the dining table.
I have a photo taken just this morning, and it was in perfect condition before the move.
I need to record this damage on your inspection form for the insurance claim.
traps: Saying 'You broke my table' is too confrontational. Use 'I noticed some damage to the table during the move.'
Saying 'It was good before' is too vague. Use 'It was in perfect condition before the move.'
Saying 'I want money' is rude. Use 'I'd like to initiate a claim for this damage.'
talk_home_moving_damage.ai: 搬家负责人，试图大事化小，说这可能是你以前就有的痕迹，不想承担责任。
talk_home_moving_damage.task: 指出损坏位置，出示搬家前的照片证据，并要求对方记录该损坏以便后续赔偿

tgt: It's been raining for three days straight.
The temperature is only 15 degrees, and it's quite chilly.
I need to make sure I wear enough layers.
traps: 说成 'It rained for 3 days'。持续至今用现在完成进行时 'It has been raining'。
说成 '15 degrees Celsius'。口语中直接说 '15 degrees' 即可。
说成 'I need to wear more clothes'。用 'wear layers' 描述叠穿保暖更地道。
soc_family_weather_chat.ai: 你的家人，提醒你多加衣服，关心你是否感冒了。
soc_family_weather_chat.task: 描述天气的阴冷和连续下雨的情况。

tgt: Hey, excuse me! Some of us haven't seen that yet, keep it down!
You just ruined the whole twist for me, seriously.
Don't tell me who the killer is, I'm watching it tonight.
traps: 说成 'You spoiled my movie.'。语义不够自然，把电影毁了和把观影体验毁了不同，地道说法是 'You ruined the ending for me.'。
说成 'Please speak lower.'。中式英语直译，表达小点声更地道的是 'Keep it down' 或 'Lower your voice'。
说成 'I am going to watch it tonight.'。虽然语法没错，但在即时口语中表达今晚有安排，用现在进行时 'I'm watching it tonight' 更有临场感。
talk_movie_cafe_spoiler_dispute.ai: Alex，那个无意中剧透的顾客。他起先有点愕然，随后笑着向你道歉，但又忍不住顺着剧情反问你知不知道幕后真凶是谁。
talk_movie_cafe_spoiler_dispute.task: 表达被剧透的不满，并制止对方继续泄露关键剧情

tgt: My left Joy-Con has been suffering from severe stick drift lately.
How much does it cost to replace the joystick module, and how long will it take?
Will this repair affect the wireless connection or HD rumble?
traps: 描述摇杆漂移直译错误：不宜说 'My button is running around.'，地道说法应用 'My joystick has stick drift.'。
询问维修时间时句式中式：不宜说 'How much time do you need to fix?'，地道说法应用 'How long will the repair take?'。
询问影响范围时搭配不当：不宜说 'Will it change other functions?'，地道说法应用 'Will this repair affect other features?'。
talk_game_switch_repair.ai: Alex 是店里的维修技术员，他会简单测试一下你的摇杆晃动情况，然后报价并告诉你预计取机时间。
talk_game_switch_repair.task: 问清更换摇杆的费用、是否当场能修好，以及会不会影响手柄其他功能

tgt: I'm really sorry to disturb you at this hour, but the AC unit in the bedroom is making a loud buzzing noise.
I've been dealing with jet lag all week and this noise is making it impossible to sleep.
Could you let me know if there's a way to reset it, or if it needs to be checked?
traps: 说成 'Your air conditioner is broken and making big sound.'，语调像是在指责，地道说法是 'The AC unit is making a loud buzzing noise.'。
说成 'I cannot sleep because the machine has sound.'，机器有声音习惯用 'making noise' 而不是 'has sound'。
说成 'Tell me how to fix it now.'，语气过于急躁，地道表达应用 'Could you let me know if there's a way to reset it?'。
hob_sleep_landlord_ac_noise.ai: Alex 扮演房东，接到深夜联系后有些惊讶，但他会在线指导你如何通过遥控器重启或关闭静音模式。
hob_sleep_landlord_ac_noise.task: 向房东描述空调噪音并请对方指导如何解决

tgt: That’s an interesting perspective, though I think every family has their own way of doing things.
Let’s focus on celebrating our friend and her exciting journey ahead.
I’m just really happy to see you both so well-prepared for this new chapter.
traps: 说成'You are wrong'，直接引发争执，应说'I see your point, but...'。
说成'It is my tradition'，容易被对方攻击，应说'It’s just something I’ve seen work'。
说成'Stop talking about this'，太没礼貌，应说'Let's keep things festive'。
soc_congrats_baby_shower_clash.ai: 育儿专家（客人）。她非常坚持自己的科学育儿观，认为你的做法是错误的，语气带有说教感。
soc_congrats_baby_shower_clash.task: 不与其正面硬刚，同时委婉地维护自己的观点，并把话题拉回到祝贺准妈妈身上。

tgt: Excuse me, the light in the hallway on the 5th floor is out.
It's completely dark over there and hard to see at night.
Could you please replace the light bulb when you have a chance?
traps: 说成 'The hallway light is dead'。虽然老外听得懂，但形容灯不亮用 'is out' 或 'doesn't work' 更地道自然。
说成 'Please change a new light bulb' 受中文“换个新灯泡”影响，加了 'new' 显得啰嗦，直接说 'replace the light bulb' 即可。
说成 'It is very dark there' 略显生硬，日常口语中用 'It's completely dark over there' 更有现场感。
life_neigh_lightbulb.ai: Alex 扮演物业管理员，很感激你提供信息，并答应马上去换灯泡。
life_neigh_lightbulb.task: 向管理员指出走廊灯坏了并请其更换

tgt: Organic produce has gotten noticeably pricier over the past year.
Is transportation really the main driver behind these vegetable prices?
It's getting tough to eat healthy without breaking the bank.
traps: 使用 "Without spending too much money"，break the bank 是更地道表达花光积蓄或超预算的习惯用语。
使用 "Why are vegetables so much expensive?"，much 不能直接修饰形容词比较级，应用 a lot more expensive。
使用 "The deliver cost is high"，动词作定语应用动名词 delivering 或 transport cost。
talk_money_vancouver_produce.ai: Alex 扮演摊主，耐心向你解释今年温室种植成本和运输燃油附加费居高不下，导致本地蔬果售价普遍偏高。
talk_money_vancouver_produce.task: 和摊主交流为什么本地农产品的价格涨得比预期快

tgt: Does the standard ticket grant access to the special Egyptian exhibition as well?
How much is the upgrade fee for the full-access pass?
Is the line for the special exhibition moving pretty fast right now?
traps: 使用 'Can I see the special show with this ticket?' 表达偏口语化，应用 'Does this ticket cover the special exhibition?'。
使用 'How much money to change ticket?' 表达不够地道，应用 'What is the cost to upgrade?'。
使用 'Is people too much inside?' 语法错误，应用 'Is it very crowded inside the gallery?'。
talk_ask_museum_ticket.ai: Alex 扮演售票员。他会告诉你普通门票只包含常设展，需要你追问如何升级门票以及特展还要排多久。
talk_ask_museum_ticket.task: 问清楚是否需要补差价买通票，以及特展现在人多不多。

tgt: It’s really impressive what you’re doing for the neighborhood, but my schedule is way too packed right now to commit to anything extra.
I’m sorry, but I just don’t have the capacity to take on a coordinating role at the moment.
I hope you find someone who has more time to contribute to the group.
traps: 说成'I am too busy'显得有点傲慢；应说'My schedule is quite packed at the moment'.
说成'I don't care about the community'非常伤人；应说'I really appreciate the initiative, but I can't be part of it'.
说成'Find someone else'语气像命令；应说'I’m sure you’ll find someone great for the position'.
soc_decline_neighborhood_committee.ai: 邻居，非常有社区责任感，觉得你很有组织能力，是合适的人选。
soc_decline_neighborhood_committee.task: 婉拒加入小组，并称赞他们的努力，以维持邻里关系。

tgt: Is there any possibility of a last-minute cancellation for the special exhibition?
I'm on a very tight schedule; is there any chance I could get a quick entry for just 30 minutes?
If today is completely booked, could you help me secure a spot for tomorrow's earliest slot?
traps: 错误说“Do you have any empty tickets?”。Empty形容空旷，应说“cancellation”或“returned tickets”。
错误说“Can I enter for a while?”。太模糊，应具体说“quick entry”或“short visit”。
错误说“I am in a hurry”作为开场白。这显得没礼貌，应先问候并礼貌请求，如“Excuse me, I wonder if...”
life_tour_museum_soldout.ai: Alex是博物馆的前台工作人员。他很忙，但愿意协助。他指出特展确实没票了，但可以帮你查查明天早上的余票或推荐周边的替代博物馆。
life_tour_museum_soldout.task: 尝试询问是否还有退票，或寻找能让你快速参观的变通方法

tgt: I happen to have an extra ticket for the Impressionist exhibition.
Would you like to go with me this Saturday at 11 AM?
We can grab a bite at the museum cafe afterwards.
traps: 用了 'I have a spare ticket for you'。听起来有点生硬，地道说法是 'I happen to have an extra ticket'。
用了 'eat simple food'。吃简餐地道表达是 'grab a bite' 或 'have a light lunch'。
用了 'look at the exhibition'。参观展览的标准动词是 'see' 或 'check out'，不用 look at。
soc_invite_museum_ticket.ai: Alex 扮演邻居 Sophia，她周末正好没事，对印象派画展很感兴趣并欣然接受。
soc_invite_museum_ticket.task: 成功把多余的特展门票送给 Sophia，并约好周六一同观展吃简餐。

tgt: Don't be too hard on yourself, hair grows back faster than you think.
Actually, it gives you a very edgy and bold look.
Why don't we try styling it with a cute headband or a cute beanie today?
traps: 安慰别难过说 'Don't cry, it's not a big thing.' 中式直译，地道表达应用 Don't be too hard on yourself。
夸发型时说 'You look very funny.' 会被误解你在嘲笑她，应用 edgy and bold look。
给建议说 'You can wear a hat.' 语气太平淡，用 Why don't we try... 更具陪伴感。
life_emo_bad_haircut_comfort.ai: Alex 扮演朋友 Amy。她会情绪低落并自我否定，觉得没脸出门见人，需要你的暖心安慰和实际的造型建议来帮她重拾信心。
life_emo_bad_haircut_comfort.task: 肯定朋友的外表，用得体的话语安慰，并给出戴发饰或帽子的补救建议

tgt: I'm going to be away for a week, and I have some plants that need watering.
Would you mind checking on them once or twice?
They only need a little water every three days.
traps: Avoid 'Can you feed my plants?' Plants are 'watered', not 'fed'.
Avoid 'Help me to water.' Use 'Would you mind watering my plants?'
Avoid 'Give them some water.' Use 'They need a little water twice a week.'
talk_home_plant_water.ai: 热心的邻居，同意帮忙，但需要确认浇水频率。
talk_home_plant_water.task: 礼貌提出请求，并说明浇水需求。

tgt: The leak seems minor, but I'm worried about the engine oil pressure. Is it safe to drive, or should I stop immediately?
Waiting three hours isn't ideal for my schedule. Are there any other options for a quicker vehicle exchange?
Could you check if there's a local partner garage that can take a look at this right now?
traps: 说 'My car is broken' 不够具体。应说 'The rental vehicle is experiencing an oil leak'。
说 'I need you to come now' 语气过强，像指使。应说 'Is there any way to expedite the rescue process?'。
说 'The car has no oil' 夸张了，应说 'The oil pressure warning light just came on'。
hob_car_oil_leak.ai: 客服人员。他认为你可能在驾驶过程中操作不当，要求你先在现场等待救援拖车，预计需要三小时。
hob_car_oil_leak.task: 评估车辆是否能缓慢驾驶至最近点，或争取更快的救援方案

tgt: Good morning, Mrs. Davis. I'm in a bit of a rush for an interview and my umbrella just broke. Would you happen to have a spare umbrella I could borrow just for this morning?
I'll make sure to drop it back off at your front desk right after my interview around noon.
Thank you so much, this is an absolute lifesaver for me.
traps: 问候说成 'Good morning, you' 违反英文称呼习惯。应该连名带姓或用尊称 'Good morning, Mrs. Davis.'
说 'My umbrella is broken' 没有突出紧急感。地道表达是 'My umbrella just broke right now' 或 'just gave out'。
承诺归还说成 'I will return it to you at twelve o'clock' 像是在下命令。用 'drop it back off around noon' 听起来更自然放松。
soc_borrow_umbrella_neighbor.ai: Alex 扮演楼长太太玛丽。她手里正好有一把住客留下的旧伞，但她提醒你这把伞的伞骨有点松，让你用的时候小心点。
soc_borrow_umbrella_neighbor.task: 向楼长太太借伞应急，并承诺下午回来时归还

tgt: I finally got a library card, which is free and lets me borrow up to ten books.
The selection here is amazing; I already picked out three classics.
I just need to be careful with the due dates, or I’ll have to pay a fine.
traps: 说成 'I get a library card'，应为 'I got a library card'。
说成 'The choice is amazing'，书籍种类用 'selection' 更地道。
说成 'I will pay money if I late'，应为 'if I return them late'。
soc_family_library_card.ai: Alex 是你的兄弟/姐妹，他/她会好奇当地图书馆的氛围，并问你是否真的会读完。
soc_family_library_card.task: 分享借书的喜悦，并展示你对阅读的规划。

tgt: We'd like to split the payment: fifty dollars in cash, forty dollars on this Visa, another forty on this Mastercard, and the rest on my Apple Pay.
Let me break down the transaction for you so it's easier to ring up.
Does your system allow split payments across four different methods?
traps: 常说 "We want to pay money by different ways"，表达非常啰嗦，地道说法是 "We'd like to split the payment across multiple methods"。
常说 "Give you fifty cash and swipe cards for others"，语法混乱，地道表达刷卡用动词 "charge" 或 "put X dollars on this card"。
常说 "Is your machine can do this?"，语法错误连篇，正确问法是 "Does your POS system support split payments with multiple cards?"。
life_eat_split_cash_card_chaos.ai: Alex 扮演收银台服务员。他面对复杂的支付组合需要你一步步说明金额，以便在POS机上准确操作。
life_eat_split_cash_card_chaos.task: 向服务员清晰解释由现金和多张卡组合的付款方案

tgt: Well, at least my morning caffeine is waking up your coat instead of me.
I promise I'm usually much more coordinated, but gravity just hates me today.
Let me cover the dry cleaning, seriously, I'm so sorry about this.
traps: 容易直译说成 'My coffee made your coat wet.'，这听起来像是在陈述毫无幽默感的事实，一点都不好笑。
容易把干洗说成 'dry wash'，英语里标准的固定搭配是 'dry cleaning'。
容易用 'I am very sorry for my mistake.'，语气太严肃像在做商务道歉，闲聊场景下用 'I'm so sorry about this' 更自然。
talk_joke_coffee_spill.ai: Alex 扮演被溅到衣服的顾客。他是个好说话的本地人，见你一脸惊慌，希望能先开口说个冷笑话或者自嘲一句，缓和一下紧张的空气，而不是板着脸。
talk_joke_coffee_spill.task: 用一句轻松的玩笑或自嘲打破尴尬，并主动提出赔偿或干洗。

tgt: I’m sorry, but could you please not feed him? He has a sensitive stomach.
I really appreciate the gesture, but he is on a strict diet.
Human food like chips isn't really good for dogs.
traps: 说成 'Don't feed him!'，语气太生硬，加上 'I’m sorry, but could you...' 更加地道且礼貌。
说成 'He is sick'，如果是肠胃敏感应说 'sensitive stomach'，'sick' 会让对方误以为狗生病了。
说成 'Chips are bad'，应具体说 'Human food isn't good for him'，这比直接评价薯片更专业。
talk_pet_dog_park_etiquette.ai: 游客，很有礼貌。他解释说只是觉得狗很馋，不知道不能随便喂食，愿意配合。
talk_pet_dog_park_etiquette.task: 委婉地阻止对方投喂并解释原因

tgt: You really saved my day when that accident happened; I owe you one.
Please, I insist you take this for a coffee on your break.
It’s just a small personal thank-you, don't worry about it.
traps: 说成 'Here is some money for you'。太像小费/贿赂，对方会觉得被冒犯；应该说 'Please take this for a coffee'。
说成 'You are a good waiter'。居高临下；应该说 'You were incredibly helpful'。
说成 'No one will see it'。这听起来像勾当；应该说 'It’s just a personal token of my appreciation'。
life_gift_waiter_favor.ai: Alex 扮演服务员，他很负责任，但他担心收礼会被经理骂，显得有些顾虑。
life_gift_waiter_favor.task: 在不让经理发现的情况下，委婉地让对方收下你的心意

tgt: What is the best way to help this vegetable-tanned leather develop a rich patina?
Should I apply mink oil or neatsfoot oil for regular conditioning?
How long does it typically take for the original color to darken into a honey brown?
traps: 问变色说 How to make it change color? 表达极度口语化且缺乏皮具圈专业感，皮革随时间变深变亮的专业词是 develop a patina。
说植鞣革用 plant leather 错得离谱，正确英文是 vegetable-tanned leather。
问护理油说 What kind of leather water should I use? 水分保护剂一般叫 conditioner 或 oil，不能叫 leather water。
hob_write_craft_leather.ai: Alex 扮演皮具匠人。他会拿出一块自己用了两年的同款样品让你看，并建议你经常涂抹天然牛脚油并多在阳光下接触。
hob_write_craft_leather.task: 向匠人问清植鞣革的日常保养与养色技巧，写进皮具专栏

tgt: Hi there, I really need to buy some essentials, are you completely closed?
Is there any way I could just grab a few things quickly?
I understand it's due to the weather, but I'm in a bit of a rush.
traps: 说成 'Open the door for me'，非常傲慢的指令，应使用 'Would it be possible to let me in for a quick purchase?'。
说成 'Why you close now?'，质疑对方，应使用 'I see you're closing early, is that because of the storm?'。
说成 'I want to buy food'，表达太随意，应使用 'I need to pick up some essential supplies'。
life_wx_shop_closed.ai: Alex 扮演店员。他表示抱歉，因为雪太大为了安全必须关门，你可以明天再来。
life_wx_shop_closed.task: 尝试询问是否能破例购买急需品

tgt: Could you please get us a box to-go for these leftover slices?
We're pretty full, do you mind packing this up for me?
Thank you so much, we'll take this to-go.
traps: 容易说成 'Pack it to home.'。'To home' 是中式英语，打包带走标准说法是 'to-go' 或 'takeout'。
容易说成 'Give me a bag for food.'。带吃剩的食物应该用 'box' 或 'container'，'bag' 通常指塑料袋。
容易说成 'I want to pack this.'。语气像在下达指令，加上 'Could you please...' 会更地道。
life_eat_packaging_leftovers.ai: Alex 扮演值台服务员。他微笑着收下你的盘子，并询问是否需要一个新的纸盒打包。
life_eat_packaging_leftovers.task: 请服务员提供一个打包盒把剩下的披萨带走

tgt: I am so sorry about the mess I made; I feel terrible.
Is there a local cleaner who can handle acrylics? Maybe that would be more cost-effective?
Can we look at the receipt for the cleaning before I cover the cost?
traps: 不要说 'I make it dirty'，应说 'I stained the carpet' 或 'I made a mess'。
不要说 'The price is too big'，价格高用 'expensive' 或 'a bit steep'。
不要说 'I don't believe you'，这会直接引起冲突，用 'Could we confirm the estimate first?' 代替。
hob_draw_paint_spill.ai: 画室房东，对地毯被弄脏非常生气，表示需要专业的干洗，报价高昂，要求你现场支付赔偿。
hob_draw_paint_spill.task: 承认错误，但对赔偿金额提出质疑，并商量寻找更经济的修复方案。

tgt: I have a runny nose and a mild cough today.
Could you recommend an over-the-counter cold medicine that doesn't cause drowsiness?
How many times a day should I take these?
traps: 词汇选择：把非处方药说成 'no need prescription medicine'。地道说法是 'over-the-counter medicine' 或简称 'OTC'。
形容词错误：把‘不嗜睡’说成 'not sleepy medicine'。地道表达是 'non-drowsy medicine' 或 'doesn't make me sleepy'。
用法询问不地道：说成 'How to eat this?'。吃药在英文里用动词 'take'，即 'How should I take this?'
talk_trip_pharmacy_cold.ai: Alex 扮演药剂师，会询问你的具体症状并推荐合适的非处方药。
talk_trip_pharmacy_cold.task: 向药剂师描述症状，买到一款不犯困的感冒药。

tgt: Oh my goodness, I am so sorry! That was completely my fault.
Please let me cover the dry cleaning costs for your uniform.
Is there anything I can do to help right now?
traps: 常说 'Sorry, I am not careful'，应说 'I'm so sorry, I was a bit clumsy'。
常说 'I pay you the money'，应说 'I'd like to cover the cleaning bill'。
常说 'My fault'，应说 'I feel terrible about this'，表达更得体。
talk_story_coffee_spill.ai: Alex 是店员，他虽然有点沮丧，但会接受你的道歉，并处理后续的清洁。
talk_story_coffee_spill.task: 表达诚挚歉意，并主动提出支付干洗费用。

tgt: Excuse me, does this downtown train stop at 86th Street?
Am I on the right platform for the uptown train?
Do I need to transfer at the next station to get to 86th Street?
traps: 说成 'Is this train to 86 Street?'。虽然能听懂，但不够地道，应用 'Does this train stop at...?' 来询问是否停靠某站。
说成 'Do you know this car can go to 86 Street?'。'car' 通常指汽车或车厢，地铁整列车应用 'train'。
问路时直接说 'Where is 86 Street train?'。缺少系动词和冠词，地道说法是 'Where can I catch the train to...?'。
life_way_subway_platform.ai: Alex 扮演站在你身边的本地通勤乘客。他很乐意帮忙，会告诉你这趟车是各站停的慢车，还是直接过站的快车。
life_way_subway_platform.task: 向旁边的人确认这趟车是否在 86 街停靠

tgt: Hi, are you taking any song requests tonight?
Do you happen to know 'Yesterday' by The Beatles?
I'd love to hear you sing it if you're comfortable with that.
traps: 说成 'Can you sing this song for me?'，太像指令，用 'Are you taking requests' 更客气。
说成 'Do you know how to sing Yesterday?'，问法像质疑水平，用 'Do you happen to know...' 更自然。
说成 'I want you to sing it'，语气太强，用 'I'd love to hear you sing it' 表示期待感。
hob_sing_song_request.ai: Alex是歌手，他刚休息结束，正准备开始下一轮表演。
hob_sing_song_request.task: 礼貌询问对方是否接受点歌

tgt: I just moved in last week, so utility bills haven't been issued under my name yet.
Would a digital bank statement showing this current address be acceptable instead?
Is there any workaround for temporary residents applying for a library card?
traps: 不要说 'My name is not on the bill yet'，表达账单还没开具地道说法是 'bills haven't been issued under my name yet'。
不要说 'Can I use a screenshot of my bank app?'，专业点的说法是 'a digital bank statement showing my current address'。
不要说 'Is there another way to solve this?'，询问替代方案或变通方法常用 'Is there any workaround for...?'。
talk_edu_library_card_issue.ai: Alex 是图书馆的前台管理员。他公事公办地解释，根据规定需要带水电账单或带有你名字的正式银行对账单才能激活账户。
talk_edu_library_card_issue.task: 向 Alex 解释你刚入住还没收到账单，询问是否可以用带新地址的网银截图或手机话费账单替代。

tgt: What are the main differences between these bleached and unbleached filters in terms of flavor?
Will the unbleached filter leave a papery aftertaste in the brew?
I'm leaning towards the bleached one to ensure a cleaner cup.
traps: 说成 'White paper or brown paper?' 显得业余。应用 'bleached' 和 'unbleached' filters。
说成 'The paper taste.' 词汇不地道。应说 'papery aftertaste'。
说成 'I choose the white one.' 缺乏语境。应用 'I’m opting for the bleached filter'。
hob_coffee_filter_paper.ai: 店员，认为原色滤纸有纸浆味，坚持认为漂白滤纸对风味还原度更好。
hob_coffee_filter_paper.task: 根据店员建议做出购买决策

tgt: My bad, I forgot that age one arrows point to the right instead of left.
Let me take those cards back and pass them to you, Matthew.
Good catch, let us restart this drafting turn properly.
traps: 容易说成『My fault, I forgot age one arrow goes left.』，方向搞反且表达生硬，地道说法是『My bad, I forgot that age one arrows point to the right instead of left.』
容易说成『Let me take cards back and pass right.』，缺少冠词和代词，地道说法是『Let me take those cards back and pass them to you, Matthew.』
容易说成『Good finding, let us do this turn again.』，名词搭配不地道，地道说法是『Good catch, let us restart this drafting turn properly.』
hob_chess_7wonders_draft_5959.ai: 马修，坐在你右边的桌游同伴。他指着你手里的卡牌包装盒说明，提醒你第一时代的箭头方向是向右传递的，你传错方向了。
hob_chess_7wonders_draft_5959.task: 查看手牌卡背的箭头方向，向马修承认并把手牌收回来传给右边

tgt: Thank you so much for looking out for me and keeping my keys safe.
I’m so embarrassed about leaving them out, but I’m really grateful you found them.
I baked these cookies as a thank you; I hope you’ll enjoy them.
traps: 不要说'You keep my keys for me'，应说'You kept my keys safe for me'，时态要正确。
不要说'I have a small gift for you, take it'，太命令式，用'I have a small token of appreciation for you'。
不要说'It's nothing, I made it'，回应对方客气时，应说'It’s just a little something I baked'。
soc_thanks_lost_keys.ai: 住隔壁的邻居，很乐意帮忙，觉得只是举手之劳，不想让你觉得太隆重。
soc_thanks_lost_keys.task: 表达歉意和谢意，并把饼干送给对方。

tgt: The postwar Allied occupation definitely forced the entertainment districts to reinvent themselves overnight.
Despite heavy socioeconomic shifts, the okiya system managed to preserve core artistic traditions.
It's remarkable how modern tourism has reshaped the daily operations of these historic teahouses.
traps: 把艺伎区说成 'geisha place'。地道说法是 'traditional entertainment district' 或 'hanamachi'。
误用 'changed a lot'。形容文化转型应用 'undergo a profound metamorphosis' 或 'redefine its operational model'。
用 'Americans did bad things to them'。地道讨论会用 'The occupational policies introduced sweeping administrative hurdles for local guilds.'。
talk_history_kyoto_geisha.ai: Alex 认为二战后美国占领军对娱乐业的管制彻底改变了祇园的传统面貌，而你认为本土茶屋文化的自我适应能力才是其延续至今的关键。
talk_history_kyoto_geisha.task: 用英语与 Alex 探讨二战后京都传统娱乐区所面临的体制冲击与文化适应

tgt: The virtual trainer isn't responding to the gradient changes in the simulation.
Could you help me pair my heart rate monitor and cadence sensor as well?
Where do I input my current FTP value in the training app settings?
traps: 把坡度变化说成 slope change。虚拟骑行里的坡度模拟通常用 gradient changes。
把功能阈值功率直接说成 power limit。骑行专业术语是 FTP（Functional Threshold Power）。
说成 link my heart rate。连接传感器的标准动词是 pair。
hob_bike_indoor_trainer.ai: Alex，房东兼骑行台主人。他帮你在笔记本电脑上重新配对阻力源，并邀请你一起参加虚拟阿尔普迪埃爬坡。
hob_bike_indoor_trainer.task: 请 Alex 帮你在软件里设置好 FTP（功能阈值功率），并开始进行阻力测试。

tgt: I'd like to adopt Plot Number 3 for growing some herbs.
Do we need to bring our own tools, or can we borrow them here?
How often should the plants be watered during the week?
traps: 说成 'I want to claim land'。'Claim' 听起来像占地为王，地道说法是 'adopt a plot'。
说成 'Do you have free tools?'。'Free' 容易让人误会是白送，借用应该说 'borrow' 或 'use the provided tools'。
说成 'How many times to water?'。语法太碎片化，地道句式是 'How often should... be watered?'。
hob_volunteer_community_garden.ai: Alex 是社区花园管理员，负责发放地块和工具。他很热情，会主动问你想种什么并指导你填写。
hob_volunteer_community_garden.task: 成功认领一块地并借到一套园艺工具

tgt: Please take it back, I didn't ask for a portrait.
I'm sorry, I cannot pay for this.
Have a nice day, I need to get going.
traps: 说 'You can't do this' 听起来像是在报警，拒绝街头纠缠通常说 'No, thank you, I don't want it.'
使用 'I have no gift' 表达语法错误，解释不需要应说 'This isn't mine, please keep it.'
直接说 'Go away' 非常粗鲁，礼貌脱身应该说 'I really have to run now, bye.'
life_no_street_art_donation.ai: Alex 扮演热情的街头画家，他坚持认为这幅画画的就是你，微笑着请你支持他的艺术创作。
life_no_street_art_donation.task: 把画退还给对方，明确表示不需要并结束对话

tgt: Excuse me, I think there was a mistake. The shelf tag said $15, but I was charged $22.
Could you double-check the price? I saw it marked as $15.
I believe this item was on sale for $15, could you verify the price?
traps: 说成 'You charged me wrong.'，语气带有指责，应说 'I think there was a mistake'。
说成 'It shows $15 on the shelf.'，比较生硬，用 'The shelf tag said' 更贴切。
说成 'Give me back $7.'，命令句，应说 'Could you refund the difference?'。
life_shop_price_diff.ai: 收银员，比较抱歉，表示会核对标签并退还差价。

tgt: We can still use those harder ones for making bread soup or croutons.
Let me count these forty bags into the donation crate.
Should I sign the pickup receipt for today's batch?
traps: 说成 'Hard bread also can eat.' 语法错误，地道说法应用 'We can still use those harder ones for making bread soup or croutons.'
说成 'I count forty bags.' 缺乏动态感，地道说法应用 'Let me count these forty bags into the donation crate.'
说成 'Where to sign paper?' 询问方式不地道，地道说法应用 'Should I sign the pickup receipt for today's batch?'
hob_volunteer_food_rescue.ai: Alex 是面包店店员，他会解释这些硬面包通常只能用来做动物饲料，问社区厨房是否收留。
hob_volunteer_food_rescue.task: 确认哪些面包可以作为慈善晚餐的食材，并完成交接清点

tgt: Hi, I am here to pick up the wooden desk.
Should I send the money via Venmo or cash?
Let's lift it together into my trunk.
traps: 把自提说成 'I come to take my desk.'。时态和语感不对，地道表达是 'I'm here to pick up the desk I reserved.'。
问对方怎么付钱说 'How should I pay to you?'。多用了介词 to，地道句型是 'How would you like me to pay?' 或 'Cash or Venmo?'。
让别人帮忙搬东西说 'Can you help me to move it?'。help 后面直接加动词原形或ing更地道，应说 'Could you help me lift this?'。
hob_collect_pick_up_marketplace_desk.ai: Alex 扮演卖书桌的邻居，正推着书桌在公寓门口等你，会主动帮忙搬上你的车后备箱。
hob_collect_pick_up_marketplace_desk.task: 确认物品无误并完成付款搬运

tgt: I was actually about to go over there myself. It was so loud!
Some people have no respect for the library rules.
I’m glad you stepped in; it was impossible to focus.
traps: 说成 'I had no way to focus.'，啰嗦。地道表达是 'It was impossible to focus'。
说成 'He should use earphones.'，语气平淡。应该说 'He should have been using headphones'。
说成 'You did good job.'，少冠词。应为 'You did a good job' 或 'Thanks for stepping in'。
soc_gossip_library_study.ai: Alex是图书馆管理员，他维护安静环境，他觉得这种行为对他人极不尊重。
soc_gossip_library_study.task: 支持Alex的做法，并表达对公共场合外放噪音的反感。

tgt: That's completely unfair to people who actually need a place to study.
Saving seats like that should really not be allowed.
I'm just glad I managed to find an empty desk today.
traps: 使用 'One person takes four seats is too much'，连动句语法错误。地道说法是 'Taking up four seats for just one person is ridiculous'。
使用 'The library should punish them strictly'，语气听起来过于严厉。地道建议是 'The library should enforce the seating rules more strictly'。
使用 'He didn't cherish the public resource'，用词过于宏大正式。口语中说 'He's just hogging the tables' 就很地道。
soc_gossip_library_desk.ai: Alex负责图书馆的日常巡视，对这种恶意占座的行为深恶痛绝，希望能得到读者的认同。
soc_gossip_library_desk.task: 附和这种占座现象确实不合理，同时表达自己对找到座位的庆幸。

tgt: I apologize, I didn't realize that even small tripods were prohibited here.
I'll pack it up immediately. Is handheld photography allowed in this gallery?
Are there any specific times or permits where photography with professional equipment is allowed?
traps: 说成 'I didn't see the sign'，像在争辩。用 'I didn't realize that...' 更平和。
说成 'Can I take pictures?'，太简单。用 'Is handheld photography allowed?' 更专业。
说成 'Where can I buy a ticket for shooting?'，用词不准。应说 'Are there any permits...?'
hob_photo_museum_tripod_rule.ai: 安保，语气严肃地要求你立刻收起，并解释这是为了防止游客被绊倒以及保护展品。
hob_photo_museum_tripod_rule.task: 立即配合收起，并礼貌询问是否可以使用手持拍摄，或者有无官方许可的特别拍摄时段。

tgt: I support charities in my own way, but I won't sign up for monthly donations.
I'm not looking to set up any recurring payments today. Sorry.
I have to be on my way now. Good luck with your campaign.
traps: 使用 'I don't want to help poor kids'，表达会引发重大误解和道德争议，地道表达应用 'I support charities in my own way, but I won't sign up for monthly donations'。
使用 'Monthly payment is too troublesome'，听起来很奇怪，地道表达应用 'I'm not looking to set up any recurring payments today'。
使用 'Stop talking to me about poor children'，极其冷漠且不礼貌，地道表达应用 'I have to be on my way now. Good luck with your campaign'。
life_no_charity_donation.ai: Alex 扮演慈善募捐人员。他会展示受助儿童的照片，并动情地解释每个月20美金对他们有多重要，劝你长期支持。
life_no_charity_donation.task: 礼貌但坚决地拒绝长期扣款，打断对方并离开。

tgt: I’m terribly sorry! I wasn't looking where I was going.
Are you okay? I hope I didn't hurt anyone.
My apologies, I'll be much more careful with the cart.
traps: 避免说 'I didn't see you'，这听起来像在找借口，应说 'I wasn't paying attention'。
避免说 'Is the basket broken?'，重心应先放在人上，应说 'Are you alright?'。
避免说 'I am sorry for my bad driving'，购物车不是车，应说 'I'm sorry for being careless with the cart'。
soc_sorry_grocery_cart.ai: Alex 是那位老太太的陪同者，他查看情况并确认人没受伤，但提醒你要注意安全。
soc_sorry_grocery_cart.task: 诚恳道歉，并确认对方身体状况。

tgt: That wait time is unacceptable given my current location.
Is there any possibility to dispatch a closer unit?
What should I do to ensure my safety while waiting here?
traps: 说成 'Two hours is too long'，虽然没语法错误但不够地道，应用 'Two hours is quite a long time to wait'。
说成 'You send someone fast'，命令口吻，应使用 'Could you expedite the dispatch'。
说成 'I feel unsafe'，应使用 'What are the safety protocols' 来更专业地沟通诉求。
soc_bad_car_breakdown.ai: 你是救援调度员。你问清了位置和车牌，并告知由于路况原因，救援车至少需要等待2个小时。
soc_bad_car_breakdown.task: 在极度焦虑下，试图让对方加快救援速度或提供替代交通方案。

tgt: Thanks so much for sharing your umbrella, it came down so suddenly!
You can say that again! Spring weather here is completely unpredictable.
Hopefully, it'll clear up by the time my lunch break ends.
traps: 说雨下的很大时说 'The rain is very big.'。雨大不能用 big，必须用 hard 或 heavily，说 'It started pouring out of nowhere.'。
赞同对方时说 'You are right.'。虽然没错，但在日常闲聊中用 'You can say that again!' 或 'Ain't that the truth!' 会更地道生动。
说希望雨停时说 'I hope the rain can stop soon.'。can 和 will 语义重复，说 'Hopefully it clears up soon.' 更加自然。
soc_small_park_umbrella.ai: Alex 扮演好心的路人。她会把伞往你这边倾斜一点，并笑着说今年春天的天气实在太捉摸不定了。
soc_small_park_umbrella.task: 向撑伞路人道谢并共用空间，顺着天气多变的话题聊两句

tgt: I don't feel comfortable knowing that previous tenants might still have keys to my apartment.
It’s a standard safety requirement to change the locks for new tenants, and I insist on having it done.
Who covers the cost if we decide to have a professional locksmith come out?
traps: 不要说 'I am scared of someone entering'，应说 'I have concerns about the security of the unit'。
不要说 'You are not safe'，这听起来像威胁，应说 'The security situation is inadequate'。
不要说 'Change the key'，应说 'Change the locks' (锁芯)。
life_rent_key_issue.ai: 房东 Alex。他觉得这太麻烦而且没必要，他认为没人会回来，且换锁的费用不应由他承担。
life_rent_key_issue.task: 坚持要求换锁，并将安全性作为核心理由，不接受对方的推诿。

tgt: I’m on a tight schedule and have to head to the next resort first thing tomorrow morning.
I’m aware of the scratch, but I really just need a basic wax for now to get through my trip.
Is there any way you could squeeze me in for just the waxing service?
traps: 说成 'I have no time' 太过生硬，建议用 'I’m on a tight schedule' 表示由于客观行程紧迫。
说成 'Please help me to fix it' 搭配不佳，应说 'Could you perform a wax on my board?'。
说成 'I must leave tomorrow' 语气过强，改用 'I have to head to...' 会更自然且带有礼貌的请求感。
hob_ski_board_waxing.ai: 店员。立场是为雪板寿命着想，坚持建议你修复划痕而非仅做表面打蜡，以免滑行时划痕扩大。
hob_ski_board_waxing.task: 说服店员只进行基础打蜡，因为你明天一早就必须出发去其他雪场，没有时间补板。
